+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst - Dublin
Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
jobs.description:
Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries

Our mission

We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience.

Our mission

We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience.

Your impact

Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.

You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.

What you'll own

  • Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

  • Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

jobs.title: Partner Manager
jobs.description:
Partner Manager

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology — increasingly agentic — solutions they build and sell.

This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia. In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

Algolia's partner motion in DACH is mature — we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Developing and executing Algolia's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland
  • Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH
  • Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region
  • Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions
  • Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners
  • Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market
  • Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users
  • Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation
  • Enabling partners on Algolia's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully
  • Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio
  • Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content
  • Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits
  • Collaborating closely with the DACH General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals
  • Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success
  • Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the DACH partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • 7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer
  • Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners
  • Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators active in the German market (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech, Diconium)
  • Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures
  • A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally with strength in the German market and familiarity with Austria and Switzerland
  • Fluency in German (spoken and written) is required, given the primary focus on the German market; fluency in English is also required
  • Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships
  • A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a multi-country region
  • A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally

€139.500—€174.500 EUR

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.

Principal Product Manager, Omnichannel CX

Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across the United States, team members located within 40 miles of our Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256) are expected to work onsite four days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our mid-market customer experience product strategy. This role is responsible for defining and delivering the capabilities that help growing businesses and BPO operators provide exceptional customer experiences while improving operational efficiency. You'll work directly with customers, partners, and internal teams to identify market opportunities, shape product direction, and bring innovative omnichannel and AI-powered experiences to market. As Nextiva continues moving up-market, you'll play a key role in ensuring our platform meets the needs of increasingly sophisticated customer service organizations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Nextiva's mid-market customer experience solutions serving organizations with 100–2,500 employees and BPO operators.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs through direct engagement with customers, prospects, internal stakeholders, and market research.
  • Define and prioritize investments across omnichannel engagement, shared inboxes, agent workspaces, workflow automation, routing, analytics, and AI-powered productivity tools.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to deliver products from concept through launch and adoption.
  • Lead product discovery efforts to validate opportunities, gather feedback, and ensure solutions solve meaningful customer problems.
  • Drive product launches and adoption strategies that support Nextiva's growth in the mid-market segment.
  • Establish success metrics and use customer insights, operational KPIs, and product telemetry to guide investment decisions.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to communicate product vision, roadmap priorities, and customer value.
  • Influence executive stakeholders through clear communication, strong business cases, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve product discovery, prototyping, decision-making, and execution while identifying opportunities to embed AI-driven capabilities into the customer experience.

About You:

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of SaaS Product Management experience, including ownership of customer-facing products from strategy through delivery.
  • Experience serving mid-market, enterprise, or BPO customer segments with a strong understanding of customer service, contact center, or customer experience workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong customer-facing skills with experience conducting customer discovery, validating requirements, and influencing product direction through customer insights.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM organizations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data to prioritize investments and measure success.
  • Familiarity with omnichannel engagement, digital customer service, messaging, social, voice, chat, or related customer interaction platforms.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, research, prototyping, product development, or decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with contact center, CCaaS, CX, workforce engagement, or customer service platforms.
  • Experience supporting BPO, outsourcing, or multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered customer experience technologies, automation, routing, agent assist, or conversational AI solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-growing company transforming the CX landscape with cutting-edge omnichannel capabilities
  • Drive the evolution of a platform serving thousands of contact center agents daily across hundreds of enterprise customers
  • Own critical features in the product roadmap with direct revenue and customer satisfaction impact
  • Work with a modern tech stack including microservices, event streaming, real-time messaging, audio/video processing, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Join a passionate, customer-obsessed culture that values autonomy, craft, and measurable impact
  • Competitive compensation, equity participation, and comprehensive benefits

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

  • Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

The expected hiring range is $130,000 - $230,000. A different level in the job hierarchy may apply to a specific candidate, resulting in a different hiring range.

jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the team behind our launch vehicles and propulsion systems. This is a hands-on, primarily onsite role focused on high-quality technical recruitment at pace.

You will partner closely with engineering and business leaders to attract exceptional talent across propulsion, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, electronics, software, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions. You will be expected to move quickly without lowering the hiring bar, while delivering an outstanding candidate experience from first contact through to offer.

Working as part of a high-performing TA function capable of supporting hyper-growth while protecting and strengthening the quality and density of talent across the company.

Fluent German is essential. A key part of the role will be developing relationships with German institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, and technical communities.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for technical and business roles, delivering a fast, structured, and high-quality hiring process.

  • Partner with hiring managers and technical leaders to define roles, calibrate requirements, build scorecards, and improve assessment quality.

  • Source exceptional candidates across propulsion, mechanical, systems, electronics, software, manufacturing, and operations.

  • Build trusted relationships with German universities, technical institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, professional networks, and specialist communities.

  • Deliver a thoughtful and responsive candidate experience while maintaining a high bar for capability, ownership, and cultural contribution.

  • Actively optimise and continuously improve the TA function, including sourcing strategy, recruitment systems, metrics, employer brand, referrals, and scalable hiring processes.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in-house or within an embedded recruitment solution; strong agency recruiters with demonstrable technical hiring results will also be considered.

  • Experience recruiting highly specialised technical talent in a fast-growing or demanding environment.

  • Fluent German and strong professional English, with the ability to build trusted relationships in both languages.

  • Demonstrated ability to source and engage hard-to-find candidates through direct outreach, networks, referrals, events, and technical communities.

  • Excellent judgement, organisation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • A proactive, high-ownership approach and the ability to work primarily onsite in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling company.

Desirable experience

  • Recruiting within a complex technical discipline such as aerospace, space, rocketry, propulsion, defence, advanced manufacturing or engineering.

  • Existing relationships with German technical institutions, universities, rocketry teams, suppliers, or engineering communities.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

jobs.title: Senior Account Lead - Client Success
jobs.description:
Senior Account Lead - Client Success

About us

ClearBank was built on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it’s the catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. That’s why our clients — financial institutions from fintech’s and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions — use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

But we wouldn’t be ClearBank without our people. They’re what powers our innovative technology and the reason we love what we do every day. We’re a group of spirited people who are never afraid to challenge the norm – becoming stronger, more energised, and that much better when we’re together.

It’s our belief in fairness, autonomy and choice that means our people are empowered with the tools to learn, grow, and contribute to ours and our clients’ success.

Interested in joining us? Read on or visit our website for more information.

About you

As a Client Director, you will join our Client Success team and play a crucial role in maintaining and growing a portfolio of some of our largest and high-growth clients. Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you’ll be a part of a fast-growing business that is challenging the market and doing things differently.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of ClearBank's Enterprise grade clients, committing to their success, and relentlessly work to remove barriers to adoption, both within their organisation and cross-functionally within ClearBank. You will be responsible for ensuring the success of our clients and driving revenue growth.

And you’ll be joining one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK, according to Deloitte Fast 50. You will be:

  • Managing and maintaining a portfolio of Enterprise client relationships, ensuring their satisfaction and success with ClearBank's services.

  • Delivering a high-quality and positive client experience, building strong relationships and trust with your clients, working towards their strategic goals.

  • Achieving clear client retention and revenue growth goals by proactively identifying and capitalising on upselling and cross-selling opportunities, working towards an annual quota.

  • Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, including Sales, Finance, Financial Crime, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Operations teams.

  • Representing and being an advocate for your clients within ClearBank, ensuring their needs and requirements are understood and addressed.

  • Conducting regular and quality engagement with your clients, maintaining a strong presence and providing ongoing support.

  • Managing a regular cadence of communication and conduct business reviews with clients

What we are looking for

  • Previous experience in commercial/sales focused relationship management roles.

  • Proven track record of achieving client retention and revenue growth targets through upselling and cross-selling to existing clients.

  • Knowledge of the banking industry and financial products is required.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to effectively engage with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels, including c-suite executives.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, able to identify and overcome barriers to adoption and drive client success.

  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively across multiple teams, fostering a culture of teamwork and shared goals.

  • Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple client relationships and prioritise tasks effectively.

  • Inquisitive and comfortable asking questions about clients' business goals, ideal state, and pain points.

  • Ability to analyse multiple problems, develop and drive solutions.

  • Confidence in working in the unknown, taking initiative, and designing processes when they don't yet exist.

  • Passion for technology and being part of a fast-growing company.

  • Good organisational skills and high attention to detail.

  • Proactive and resourceful, able to take ownership and drive results.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

 

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

 

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.

  • Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information.

  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.

  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.

  • Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up.

  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.

  • Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning.

  • Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems.

  • Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively.

jobs.description:
Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

          

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

 

L’ENSTA est l’un des partenaires du projet SEARENITY, retenu dans le cadre de l'appel à projets « CORIMER Navire Bas Carbone » (financement Ademe, France 2030). Le projet vise à développer un robot autonome capable d’intervenir en continu sur les coques de navires pour les nettoyer et limiter l’apparition d’algues et coquillages afin de réduire sa consommation énergétique et ses émissions de C02.

L’ENSTA intervient sur 2 aspects du projet pour lequel les verrous techniques sont nombreux et pointus :

  • le système d’attraction magnétique : définition, simulation et tests.

  • le volet hydrodynamique du robot : modélisation, simulation numérique et essais en veine aérodynamique

La présente fiche de poste concerne les aspects hydrodynamiques.

 

Missions / Activités principales :

 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge l’évaluation numérique des efforts subis par le robot dans différentes configurations d’opération, et proposera des pistes d’optimisation de forme, afin d’améliorer les performances. Les modèles développés seront également confrontés à des essais de validation dans la nouvelle veine aérodynamique de l’école. Elle sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des outils de simulation numérique et des essais, et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet SEARENITY.

 

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

 

  1.   Etude expérimentale en soufflerie

Essais de caractérisation et de validation en veine aérodynamique, afin de valider les simulations numériques pour l’estimation des efforts, en fonction de différents paramètres (influence de la vitesse de l’écoulement, influence de l’angle d’incidence). Mise en place du protocole d’essais, conception du support et impression 3D du modèle réduit de drone, calibrage des capteurs, mise en œuvre de la veine aérodynamique.

 

2.   Etude numérique pour le fonctionnement en zone immergée

Détermination numérique des efforts moyens rencontrés par le drone en condition réelle le long de la coque. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées avec un code de calcul commercial validé, constituant l’une des références à l’heure actuelle pour la simulation d’écoulements à haut Reynolds.

 

3.   Dimensionnement des efforts d’impact en splash-zone

Détermination numérique des efforts d’impact à la traversée de la surface libre, pour différentes vitesses du navire, et différents angles d’incidence du drone. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées à l’aide d’un code de calcul développé par l’ENSTA, spécifiquement dédié aux cas d’impacts. Plusieurs trajectoires de rentrée dans l’eau seront simulées, afin de cerner les efforts maximaux subis par la structure.

 

4.   Optimisation de forme du robot

Le fonctionnement nominal du drone en zone immergée, et la phase d’entrée dans l’eau conduisent à des formes géométriques optimales très différentes. Une étude bibliographique sera menée pour orienter la recherche d’une forme extérieure la plus adaptée, au sens d’un compromis sur les efforts acceptables. Cette étude bibliographique sera éventuellement complétée par des calculs de traînée et d’impact sur des géométries académiques, afin de fournir une aide à la décision pour les concepteurs du drone.

Niveau de diplôme et formations

 

Bac +5 première expérience – 2-3 ans d’expérience serait un plus dans le domaine naval

 

 Emploi

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 12 mois

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 01/01/2027

Rémunération :

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny, 29200 Brest

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  •  Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •  Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  •  Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  •  Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  •  Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

Présentation de l’Ecole

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Connaissances : 

 

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Formation supérieure en mécanique des fluides, énergétique, mécanique, génie maritime ou domaine équivalent.

  • Solides connaissances en mécanique des fluides et en hydrodynamique navale.

  • Expérience en simulation numérique des écoulements (CFD) et en analyse de résultats de calcul.

  • Maîtrise d'au moins un langage de programmation scientifique (Python, C/C++, Fortran…).

  • Compétences en traitement, analyse et visualisation de données scientifiques.

  • Autonomie, rigueur scientifique, capacité à travailler en équipe et à conduire des campagnes de calculs et d'essais.

  • Bon niveau d'anglais scientifique.

 

Les compétences suivantes seraient appréciées :

  • Compétences en méthodes particulaires, notamment en méthode SPH, ou intérêt marqué pour leur mise en œuvre.

  • Expérience en expérimentation en mécanique des fluides.

  • Connaissances en optimisation numérique et/ou optimisation de géométrie.

  • Des connaissances en calcul parallèle/HPC

 

Logiciels : 

 

  • Rhinoceros 3D, CATIA

  • FINE/Marine

  • Paraview, Tecplot

 

Savoir-faire: 

 

  • Savoir planifier son temps et s’organiser

  • Savoir rechercher l’information

  • Compétences rédactionnelles de rapports techniques

  • Appréhender des systèmes inconnus

 

Savoir-être:

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

 

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant.

Les objectifs principaux du projet sont :

  1. Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique.

  2. Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori.

La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant.

 

Missions / Activités principales :

 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse.

 

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

 

Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin

 

Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille.

Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle.

 

Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif

 

Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone.

Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur.

Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires.

 

Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques

 

Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif.

 

Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel

 

Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement.

Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales.

 

Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin

 

Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …).

Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés.

Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle.

 

Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel

 

Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement.

 

Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique.

Niveau de diplôme et formations

 

Thèse de doctorat dans le domaine de l’hydrodynamique navale.

jobs.description:
Data Centre Safety Manager

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Our mission

Build and lead a practical, high-trust health and safety program for Mistral AI’s rapidly expanding data center operations. You will protect employees, contractors and visitors while enabling safe deployment and operation of increasingly dense AI compute infrastructure across colocation sites. You will turn complex operational risks into clear standards, effective controls and measurable improvements.

Operating context & accountability

You will be the safety partner to Data Center Operations, IT Operations, infrastructure delivery, Security, Legal and People teams, and work directly with colocation operators, installation contractors and OEM service partners. Your remit spans live sites, deployment projects, commissioning and transitions into operations. You will ensure that safety responsibilities are clearly defined and that Mistral-controlled activities meet applicable requirements while challenging partner performance where shared interfaces create risk.

Key responsibilities - safety management and compliance

  • Own the operational health and safety management framework for the data center portfolio: policy, critical-risk standards, annual objectives, assurance calendar, risk registers, incident classifications, documentation and management reporting.

  • Interpret applicable occupational health and safety requirements with local specialists; translate them into site-level expectations, control plans and auditable evidence across different countries.

  • Lead regular risk assessments, inspections and assurance reviews; prioritize findings by severity and exposure, assign owners and verify corrective actions have actually reduced risk.

  • Create consistent arrangements for site access, inductions, competency checks, contractor onboarding, safety briefings and refresher training, including evidence of completion.

  • Develop meaningful leading and lagging indicators, including high-potential near misses, overdue critical actions, training coverage, contractor observations and incident trends; present clear recommendations to leadership.

  • Support supplier selection and contract reviews by defining appropriate safety requirements, escalation expectations and minimum standards for colocation and technical service partners.

Key responsibilities - operational and technical risk

  • Provide safety oversight for electrical work interfaces, energized equipment, isolation and lockout/tagout, switching coordination, arc-flash exposure and simultaneous activities in live data halls.

  • Assess safe systems of work for heavy rack deliveries, lifting and rigging, material handling, battery systems, working at height, temporary works, confined spaces where relevant and high-density IT installation.

  • Review method statements, risk assessments, permits to work and job safety analyses for high-risk activities, ensuring that scope, boundaries, competence, emergency arrangements and hold points are understood.

  • Partner with engineering teams on the risks introduced by direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, coolant handling, pressurized circuits, leak detection, hot surfaces and changing rack densities.

  • Participate in readiness reviews before energization, commissioning, major deployments and changes in operating configuration; confirm critical safety issues are resolved or escalated before work proceeds.

  • Coordinate emergency planning and drills with colocation operators and emergency responders for fire, evacuation, electrical incidents, coolant leaks, medical emergencies and loss of critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities - investigations and culture

  • Lead or coordinate investigations of incidents, unsafe conditions and high-potential near misses involving Mistral activities; use structured causal analysis and share actionable learning across the portfolio.

  • Challenge the completeness and quality of provider or contractor investigations when Mistral personnel or equipment may be exposed; track preventive measures through verification.

  • Coach engineers, managers and vendors to identify hazards early, stop unsafe Mistral-controlled work and raise concerns without hesitation.

  • Build strong partnerships with operations, construction, logistics, physical security, compliance and HR; communicate safety expectations clearly in written guidance, training and site discussions.

  • Provide practical support to other regions during major incidents, rapid expansion or unusual operational risk.

What success looks like

  • Critical activities are governed by clear, adopted controls and a consistent standard across sites.

  • High-severity findings are visible, owned and resolved; incident learning results in verified preventive action.

  • Site and contractor training, emergency readiness and compliance evidence are maintained and readily accessible.

  • The safety program scales with infrastructure growth without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 5 years of practical health and safety experience in operational, industrial, construction or mission-critical environments.

  • Experience implementing safety programs, contractor controls, inspections, risk assessments, investigations and training.

  • Working knowledge of occupational safety regulations and high-risk work controls; ability to coordinate country-specific requirements.

  • Strong communication and influencing skills across technical teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders; fluent professional English.

  • Ability to work regularly on site and travel between data center locations; valid driving licence where required for site access.

Preferred qualifications

  • Data center, manufacturing, power infrastructure or complex construction experience involving employees and multiple contractors.

  • Experience with electrical safety, critical mechanical systems, commissioning and work in live operational facilities.

  • Recognized HSE qualification and familiarity with ISO 45001-based management systems.

  • Experience with international portfolios, colocation operators and high-density IT or liquid-cooled systems.

Design & Reliability Engineering Manager

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Our mission

Shape the engineering foundations of Mistral AI’s next generation of compute capacity while improving the resilience of the infrastructure already in service. This role combines technical design leadership with field reliability engineering: you will establish demanding, practical requirements for colocation power and cooling, scrutinize proposed solutions and turn operating experience into better designs, safer changes and more reliable AI capacity.

Operating context & accountability

Mistral deploys high-density AI infrastructure in colocation facilities, where partners operate the underlying critical plant. You will be Mistral’s technical counterpart to providers, designers, commissioning specialists and internal IT and capacity teams. The position combines forward-looking design authority with hands-on technical investigation and portfolio reliability improvement. It requires depth in one core engineering discipline and the judgment to lead multidisciplinary decisions with specialist support.

Key responsibilities — design and technical standards

  • Own and continuously improve Mistral’s technical design criteria and colocation requirements for new facilities, expansions and retrofits, including availability objectives, failure domains, maintainability and operational flexibility.

  • Translate GPU platform roadmaps into measurable facility envelopes: IT load and transients, rack density, electrical topology, redundancy, cooling capacity, supply/return temperatures, flow, pressure, water quality and monitoring.

  • Review utility and MV/LV arrangements, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busway, protection coordination, earthing, power quality and metering for suitability under demanding AI loads.

  • Review mechanical and controls architecture, including chilled-water and heat-rejection systems, pumps, control sequences, CDU integration, leak detection, filtration, water treatment and cooling recovery scenarios.

  • Lead multidisciplinary reviews of single-line diagrams, P&IDs, sequences of operation, design calculations, capacity models, failure-mode studies and proposed deviations; document risks and decisions.

  • Participate in site selection, technical due diligence, provider RFPs, design milestones and commercial technical schedules, challenging assumptions before they become delivery constraints.

  • Define design review and exception processes that balance performance, resilience, deployment speed, efficiency, capital cost and long-term operability.

Key responsibilities — commissioning and delivery assurance

  • Partner with delivery and commissioning teams to define functional and integrated testing requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence packages and outstanding-defect management.

  • Validate that electrical and cooling infrastructure can support the contracted AI load envelope under normal, maintenance and credible fault conditions.

  • Review test scripts and results for loss of utility, UPS/generator transitions, cooling component failures, controls faults, CDU interface events and staged restoration where applicable.

  • Ensure operational handover includes accurate drawings, asset and interface registers, monitoring points, setpoints, maintenance constraints, emergency procedures and unresolved risk ownership.

  • Support live-site changes and capacity upgrades with a disciplined review of impact, sequencing, rollback plans and operational readiness.

Key responsibilities — field reliability and root-cause analysis

  • Act as a technical escalation point for recurring or high-impact electrical, mechanical and controls incidents across operational colocation sites.

  • Analyze alarms, BMS/EPMS trends, event sequences, power-quality records, cooling telemetry, commissioning findings and maintenance evidence to distinguish symptoms from systemic causes.

  • Lead or challenge technical root-cause investigations with colocation partners, including common-mode failures, protection miscoordination, thermal instability, control logic, hydraulic performance and hidden capacity limitations.

  • Develop risk-ranked corrective actions and reliability improvement programs; validate effectiveness through evidence and post-change monitoring.

  • Identify fleet-wide patterns and feed lessons learned into reference designs, acceptance tests, technical specifications and provider governance.

  • Review maintenance and change proposals that create material exposure to compute availability, providing clear technical recommendations and escalation where required.

Key responsibilities — collaboration and leadership

  • Work with IT hardware, network and platform teams to understand the operational consequences of rack-level and cluster-level failure domains.

  • Influence colocation providers, consultants and OEM partners through technically rigorous, fact-based reviews without relying on direct operational authority.

  • Present design trade-offs, reliability risks and investment recommendations in language accessible to engineering leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Develop reusable standards, technical playbooks and engineering knowledge sharing to support consistent decisions across a rapidly expanding portfolio.

What success looks like

  • New capacity is accepted against well-defined electrical, thermal and resilience criteria with transparent technical exceptions.

  • Design risks are identified early, reducing late changes, stranded capacity and avoidable operational constraints.

  • Repeat incidents and unresolved critical engineering defects decrease as corrective actions are verified.

  • Field experience produces measurable improvements to future designs and live-site operating resilience.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 8 years in mission-critical data center design, engineering, commissioning or technical reliability, including responsibility for complex technical decisions.

  • Degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent professional experience, with deep knowledge in one discipline and strong working knowledge of the other.

  • Demonstrated expertise in critical power and cooling architecture, redundancy, failure-mode analysis and operational risk management.

  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, calculations, commissioning evidence and root-cause analyses, and coordinating technical specialists.

  • Ability to influence colocation providers and cross-functional stakeholders; excellent English communication and willingness to travel.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with AI/HPC infrastructure, high-density accelerator platforms and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

  • Knowledge of CDUs, facility-to-technology cooling interfaces, hydraulic performance, cooling-water quality and leak management.

  • Experience with electrical protection/selectivity, power quality, controls sequences, integrated systems testing and BMS/EPMS analytics.

  • Experience creating technical standards across multiple sites or providers, including design deviations and fleet-wide reliability improvements.

  • Professional engineering registration or equivalent technical credentials.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Frontend Engineer

About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

What we offer

  • A laptop on Mac, Windows, or Linux

  • 32 or 40 hours workweek

  • Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office

  • 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract

  • Pension plan

  • NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed.

  • Training budget for personal development

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.
