jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven products across Nebius. We ingest data from internal and external systems, develop reliable transformation pipelines and data models, and make trusted datasets available to business and product teams.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own substantial parts of our data platform and deliver complex data products end to end. You will turn ambiguous business needs into pragmatic technical solutions, make architecture and implementation trade-offs, and improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data ecosystem.

You will work closely with product, platform, and business teams, helping them use data effectively while ensuring that our systems remain maintainable and trustworthy as Nebius grows.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of complex data pipelines, datasets, and platform components.
  • Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data models, reliable data products, and clear technical plans.
  • Design and evolve data architecture, storage, processing, and orchestration patterns for large-scale workloads.
  • Improve data quality, observability, lineage, and incident response for critical datasets and pipelines.
  • Investigate and resolve challenging performance, reliability, and data-correctness issues in production.
  • Establish reusable tools, conventions, and automation that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational risk.
  • Work with product teams and business stakeholders to define data contracts, priorities, and success criteria.
  • Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, thoughtful trade-offs, and documentation.
  • Support and mentor other engineers through reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

Director, People Operations

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability for a growing global company. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm.

This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own managing the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders.

Responsibilities:

People Operations Leadership

  • Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery.
  • Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support.
  • Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Improve the consistency, quality, and equity of the employee experience across U.S. and international processes while accounting for local requirements and operational complexity.
  • Build scalable documentation, self-service resources, controls, and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable manual work and improve accuracy.
  • Manage key People Operations vendors and partnerships, including service quality, contracts, issue resolution, risk management, and performance against expectations.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations issues, using sound judgment, discretion, and a strong understanding of employee trust and business risk.

Talent Acquisition Operations

  • Establish the operating model for Talent Acquisition Operations, including recruiting intake, role setup, approvals, job posting workflows, interview coordination, interview loop management, candidate communications, offer process support, and recruiting operations reporting.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to improve recruiter and coordinator capacity, operating discipline, candidate experience, hiring-manager partnership, and consistency across recruiting workflows.
  • Establish clear ownership and service standards across recruiting operations, including intake quality, scheduling, interview readiness, candidate handoffs, and offer-to-onboarding transitions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen Greenhouse and connected recruiting workflows in partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics and technical partners.
  • Support scalable recruiting programs, vendor management, executive recruiting operations, contingent recruiting processes, and other Talent Acquisition priorities as the business evolves.
  • Use recruiting and operational signals to surface bottlenecks, clarify tradeoffs, and recommend improvements to hiring velocity, quality, candidate experience, and team capacity.

Partnership with People Programs, Systems & Analytics

  • Partner with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics to maintain one integrated roadmap across People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, People programs, systems, analytics, and AI.
  • Translate operational pain points and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, process improvements, system enhancements, reporting needs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Jointly define operating metrics, service-level expectations, data requirements, and success measures for employee and candidate lifecycle processes.
  • Ensure new systems, workflows, programs, and automation are operationally sound, documented, adopted, and supported after launch.
  • Partner on data quality, process governance, access controls, reporting definitions, and responsible use of automation and AI involving employee or candidate information.
  • Create a disciplined operating rhythm for prioritization, dependency management, risk review, decision-making, and communication across the People portfolio.

Cross-functional Partnership and Change

  • Partner closely with HRBPs, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, AppEng, TechOps, Payroll, Workplace, Internal Communications, and external vendors to deliver reliable People and Talent processes.
  • Lead change adoption for operational changes, including stakeholder alignment, communications, training, readiness, issue management, and post-launch improvement.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous work, identify root causes, and make practical decisions that balance employee experience, candidate experience, compliance, speed, scalability, and cost.
  • Represent People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations in cross-functional planning, business reviews, and executive discussions.
  • Build strong relationships with business leaders and managers so People processes are understood, usable, and aligned to business needs.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, Talent Operations, shared services, or a similarly complex People function, including 5 years leadership experience across both employee and candidate lifecycle operations.
  • Demonstrated success designing or scaling a global People Operations or Talent Acquisition Operations operating models at both small as well as medium-to-large sized companies.
  • Experience leading and developing teams across multiple operational disciplines, with a track record of creating clarity, accountability, and strong service delivery.
  • Strong understanding of employee lifecycle operations, recruiting operations, HR compliance, employee data, HR systems, recruiting systems, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience with Greenhouse or an equivalent recruiting system, including workflows, approvals, reporting, integrations, or process improvement.
  • Experience improving operational controls, documentation, self-service, service delivery, data quality, and process consistency at scale.
  • Experience designing, managing, or improving integrations across HR systems and connected People tools to support reliable data flows and scalable operations.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Finance, IT, Payroll, HRBPs, Recruiting, and business leaders on sensitive or high-impact work.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential employee and candidate information, compliance-related matters, escalations, and employee experience risks.
  • Strong program management, prioritization, change leadership, written communication, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to use data and operational metrics to diagnose issues, set priorities, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations.
  • Willingness to remain close enough to the work to understand process details, remove barriers, and personally solve complex problems when needed.

About You:

  • You are a thoughtful, service-oriented People leader who combines operational discipline with empathy and care.
  • You create clarity in complex environments and are comfortable making decisions when ownership, process, or information is incomplete.
  • You see the connections between People Operations, Talent Acquisition, systems, data, compliance, and employee experience.
  • You are hands-on enough to understand how work gets done and strategic enough to build a model that scales.
  • You build trust through sound judgment, transparency, follow-through, and respect for confidential information.
  • You are collaborative and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • You care about creating consistent, equitable, and people-centered experiences for employees, candidates, managers, and internal partners.

What Success Looks Like:

  • People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations have clear ownership, service standards, escalation paths, and operating rhythms.
  • Employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders experience more consistent, responsive, and equitable support.
  • Core employee and candidate lifecycle processes are documented, measurable, scalable, and supported by appropriate controls and self-service resources.
  • People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams are engaged, capable, and organized around the highest-value work.
  • Greenhouse and connected workflows support a reliable, efficient, and high-quality recruiting experience in partnership with the People systems function.
  • The People team has a clear, integrated roadmap across operational execution, programs, systems, analytics, and AI, with well-managed dependencies and decisions.
  • Operational risks, data-quality issues, manual work, and process fragmentation are identified early and reduced over time.
  • People leaders and business partners trust the function to deliver practical solutions, communicate clearly, and follow through on commitments.

Engineering Manager

About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Thermal analysis engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our vehicle. As Thermal analysis engineer, you will be in charge of the thermal modeling and simulations to support the design definition and justification of the vehicle. You will work closely with our mechanical, CAD, avionics and mechanism engineers to optimize together the vehicle design, thermal architecture and performance. You will be part of the Nyx Thermal and ECLSS Team and will report to the Space Vehicle Thermal Team Leader.

  • To generate the thermal and fluids models, with the right level of complexity depending on the maturity and the goals of the study,

  • To provide technical solutions on optimizing the design and the spacecraft thermal management, in collaboration with other subsystems,

  • To support the test campaign preparation: test plan definition, exploitation for simulation comparison and correlation,

  • Advanced degree (Master of Science or PhD) in aerospace engineering, heat transfer and fluid mechanics, or another related field,

  • At least 4 years of experience in thermal analysis,

  • Good knowledge of thermal management for both active and passive thermal control systems,

  • Deep knowledge of thermal and fluid analysis,

  • Experience with several thermal software (Thermal Desktop, ESATAN, Systema),

  • Experience with programming (Python, Matlab...),

jobs.title: Composite CAD Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Composite CAD Design Engineer

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


Here at the The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Composite CAD design engineer to help us in our mission by designing and developing our composite structures for our spacecraft.

Mission

As a Composite Design Engineer, you will:

  • Drive the design, modelling, and integration of composite parts and assemblies, ensuring optimal performance, manufacturability, and compliance with mission requirements.

  • Be a key contributor to the definition and maturation of the vehicle’s composite architecture, from concept to detailed design and industrialization.

  • Support to the definition and maturation of the vehicle's metallic parts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Composite CAD Modelling: Build and mature CAD models of composite structures and sub-systems using Siemens NX (Fibersim experience highly valued), including layup definition, ply book creation, and integration with metallic and non-metallic parts.

  • Metallic CAD modelling: To support the design, modelling, and integration of metallic parts and assemblies, ensuring their compatibility and integration with the overall vehicle architecture.

  • Design for Manufacturing: Collaborate with manufacturing and process engineers to ensure designs are producible, cost-effective, and meet quality standards. Propose layup sequences, manufacturing processes, and tolerances.

  • Material & Process Selection: Collaborate with the mechanical engineers to select appropriate composite materials (e.g., CFRP, sandwich panels) and processes, considering mission environments, thermal and mechanical loads, and supplier capabilities.

  • Analysis Integration: Work closely with structural and thermal analysts to iterate designs based on FEA results, trade-offs, and test feedback.

  • Documentation & Reviews: Prepare and release technical drawings, ply books, and design documentation. Participate in design reviews and support the qualification of composite parts.

  • Configuration & Mass Management: Ensure configuration control of composite models and contribute to the vehicle mass budget tracking.

  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of composite design tools, databases, and best practices.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Engage in co-engineering sessions with mission analysis, propulsion, avionics, GNC, and system teams to ensure robust, integrated solutions.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering,

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in composite design for aerospace or high-performance applications.

Senior Geospatial Consultant (FME)

Senior Geospatial Consultant (FME)

Location: UK (VertiGIS HQ is in Cambridge, UK - Hybrid Working Available) or Ireland (Remote Working)
Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent

About VertiGIS

At VertiGIS, we help organisations unlock the full value of their geospatial data. Our solutions enable customers across utilities, telecommunications, government, infrastructure and commercial sectors to manage assets, optimise workflows and make smarter, data-driven decisions. We combine industry expertise with powerful geospatial technologies to deliver real-world outcomes for our customers.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Senior Geospatial Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced consultant who enjoys solving complex data challenges, working closely with customers, and delivering high-quality geospatial solutions.

We welcome applications from candidates based in both the United Kingdom and Ireland with the opportunity to be based remotely or hybrid working from our Cambridge head office.

The Role

As a Senior Geospatial Consultant, you will work with customers to deliver data transformation, migration, integration, and quality improvement projects across a range of geospatial environments.  You will play a key role in project delivery, leading technical workstreams, engaging directly with customers, and supporting the development of less experienced team members. You will help organisations improve the quality, accessibility and value of their spatial data while contributing to the successful delivery of strategic programmes.

We use the SFIA framework to assess competencies and expect to appoint this role at Level 3-4, depending on experience, with opportunities for progression as your responsibilities and expertise grow.  The successful candidate will work across a range of technologies, with a particular focus on FME as a core platform for data integration, transformation and automation. Experience with enterprise GIS platforms and spatial databases will also be valuable.  Further training in our own complementary data and application products will be provided. 

Travel to customer locations may occasionally be required.  Due to the nature of our work it is essential that candidates are able and willing to obtain and maintain UK Security Check (SC) Clearance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of geospatial consultancy projects from discovery through to implementation.

  • Design and implement data transformation, migration and integration workflows.

  • Build, maintain and optimise FME workspaces and automation processes.

  • Deliver geospatial data quality, validation and improvement initiatives.

  • Support the implementation and adoption of VertiGIS and third-party geospatial technologies.

  • Develop technical documentation, specifications and delivery artefacts.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to colleagues.

  • Contribute to solution design, best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support pre-sales activities, workshops and customer demonstrations where required.


Essential Skills & Experience: 

  • Degree or equivalent experience in GIS, Geography, Geospatial Science, Computer Science, Data Management, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Experience with spatial databases and data management principles.

  • Strong experience working with geospatial and spatially enabled datasets.

  • Experience delivering customer-facing consultancy or technical project work.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

Desirable Skills:

We are particularly interested in candidates with strong experience of Safe Software FME Form and FME Flow (certifications are highly desirable) including:

  • Support pre-sales activities, workshops and customer demonstrations where required.

  • Data migration and ETL workflows

  • Data validation, cleansing and transformation

  • Workflow automation and integration design

  • Performance optimisation and troubleshooting

    Additional desirable skills and experience includes:

  • 1Spatial 1Integrate / 1DataGateway

  • 1Spatial 1Integrate / 1DataGateway

  • ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro or ArcGIS Online

  • QGIS and open-source geospatial technologies

  • PostGIS and PostgreSQL

  • SQL and database design

  • Python scripting and automation

  • Utility, telecommunications, infrastructure or government datasets

What We Offer:

  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements

  • Professional certification support

  • Access to mentoring and career development pathways

  • Opportunity to work with industry-leading geospatial technologies

  • Collaborative and supportive international team environment

    In addition to... 

  • Generous annual leave allowance plus your birthday as a Gifted Day

  • Free gym access at our Cambridge office 

  • Option to buy or sell annual leave 

  • Company Pension scheme

  • Group Income Protection scheme and Life Assurance 

  • Private Health Insurance and Health Cash Plan 

  • Inclusive Fertility and Pregnancy Loss Leave (also accessible to partners)

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave 

  • Annual Personal Development Allowance

Interested?

Please submit your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your relevant experience and confirming your eligibility for security clearance

Our HR team will be reviewing applications initially, and if your experience and skills seem like a great fit, we'll be sure to connect! 

You can expect a call from the hiring manager to chat about the role, your background, and how you could contribute to our team. Then there will be an interview where you'll also have the chance to:

  • Meet some future colleagues

  • Ask any questions you have

  • If we're not quite the right match, we'll let you know why, so you can continue your job search with valuable feedback. 

Please note that we require that all candidates are able to demonstrate their eligibility to work in the UK or Ireland

My GOOD LIFE recrute !
Rejoignez un projet innovant à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la vidéo et de l’Activité Physique Adaptée

My GOOD LIFE développe des solutions et des contenus visant à promouvoir l’Activité Physique Adaptée auprès de différents publics, notamment les personnes souhaitant reprendre une activité physique, préserver leur autonomie ou améliorer leur qualité de vie.

Dans le cadre de son développement, My GOOD LIFE souhaite intégrer l’intelligence artificielle générative à la conception de supports vidéo pédagogiques, accessibles et adaptés aux besoins des différents publics.

Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons notre futur(e) :

Stagiaire en intelligence artificielle générative et création de contenus vidéo APA (H/F)

Votre mission

Encadré(e) par notre équipe, vous participez à la conception et à la production de vidéos d’Activité Physique Adaptée grâce aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative.

Votre mission consiste à expérimenter différents outils, concevoir et optimiser des prompts, générer des contenus vidéo et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de leur qualité pédagogique et visuelle.

À la fois créatif(ve), rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous participez à la construction d’une méthodologie permettant de produire des contenus cohérents, réalistes, accessibles et adaptés aux objectifs de l’Activité Physique Adaptée.

Vos principales responsabilités

Vous intervenez notamment sur les volets suivants :

  • Concevoir, tester et optimiser des prompts destinés aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative.

  • Générer des vidéos illustrant des mouvements, exercices et séances d’Activité Physique Adaptée.

  • Tester et comparer différentes solutions de génération vidéo, d’animation, d’avatars et, si nécessaire, de voix off.

  • Améliorer la fluidité des mouvements, la posture, la cohérence visuelle et la clarté des consignes proposées.

  • Participer à la création de contenus pédagogiques adaptés à différents publics et niveaux de pratique.

  • Analyser les résultats obtenus et faire évoluer les prompts afin d’améliorer progressivement la qualité des productions.

  • Formaliser une méthodologie de production en documentant les prompts utilisés, les outils mobilisés, les résultats obtenus et les bonnes pratiques.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous préparez une formation dans l’un des domaines suivants : intelligence artificielle, informatique, audiovisuel, multimédia, design numérique, création de contenus digitaux ou ingénierie pédagogique.

Vous êtes particulièrement intéressé(e) par les usages concrets de l’intelligence artificielle générative et souhaitez participer à un projet associant technologie, mouvement, sport et santé.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :

  • Votre capacité à rédiger des instructions précises et structurées ;

  • Votre intérêt pour les outils d’IA générative et de création vidéo ;

  • Votre capacité à expérimenter, comparer et améliorer les résultats obtenus ;

  • Votre sens de l’image, de la pédagogie et du détail ;

  • Votre autonomie, votre créativité et votre rigueur ;

  • Votre esprit d’initiative et votre curiosité.

Une première expérience avec des outils de génération vidéo par IA, de création d’avatars ou de montage vidéo constitue un véritable atout.

Une connaissance du domaine sportif, de la santé ou de l’Activité Physique Adaptée sera également appréciée.

Pourquoi rejoindre My GOOD LIFE ?

Vous rejoignez un projet innovant qui associe intelligence artificielle, création de contenus vidéo et Activité Physique Adaptée.

Ce stage vous permettra d’expérimenter concrètement les nouveaux outils de génération vidéo, de développer vos compétences en prompt engineering et de participer à la création de contenus ayant une finalité pédagogique et d’utilité sociale.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement favorisant l’expérimentation, la créativité, l’autonomie et l’acquisition de nouvelles compétences techniques.

Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.

This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.

This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.

Bid Management - from first read to submission

  • Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

  • Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

  • Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

  • Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

  • Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game

  • Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

  • Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

  • Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

  • Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

Project Delivery - from award to acceptance

  • Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

  • Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

  • Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

  • Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

Process & Reporting

  • Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

  • Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

  • Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

  • Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

  • At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

  • Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

Skills & Qualities

  • Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

  • Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

  • Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

  • Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

  • A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

  • A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

  • Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

  • Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

  • Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

Nice to Have

  • APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

  • Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consortium, or with NSPA/NCIA procurement

  • A background in a NATO agency, the EDA or a ministry of defence, or military service (officer or NCO)

  • Knowledge of C-UAS, air defence, ISR or drones

  • Export-control experience (French export licensing, EU dual-use rules)

Security

  • This position will require applying for a NATO personnel security clearance; it is therefore open to nationals of EU Member States that are also NATO members, and the hire is subject to the clearance procedure

Languages

  • Professional English, written and spoken (C1) is mandatory

  • French is a strong plus

  • Polish, Romanian, Lithuanian or Ukrainian is a plus

Travel

  • Regular travel to NATO agencies (Brussels, Luxembourg, The Hague), EU institutions, and to demos and acceptance tests across Europe

jobs.description:
Post-doctorant(e) : Problèmes publics des centres de données - Chaire SHS TerrAINs - CDD de 18 mois

Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs.

Contexte scientifique :

La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029).

Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données (data centers) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude.

Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement.

Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ?

Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie.

En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action, TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains.

La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux :

  1. Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ;

  2. Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale.

  3. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques.

Vos missions principales seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains

  • Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe

  • Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant)

Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée.


Nous recherchons une personne avec un profil SHS – interdisciplinaire (humanités environnementales, Science and Technology Studies (STS) ou anthropologie expérimentale, géographie sociale, architecture / design…) avec une solide maîtrise théorique et empirique des transformations socio-environnementales, des savoirs situés, des problèmes publics, de l’enquête collective et des relations entre sciences / société. 

Niveau de diplôme exigé : doctorat ou équivalent

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée.

Dossier de candidature à envoyer avant le 20 novembre :

  • un CV détaillé

  • une lettre (2-3 pages max) qui esquisse les contributions que le ou la candidat·e souhaiterait apporter au sein de la Chaire ainsi que sa motivation à y prendre part;

  • deux publications significatives au regard de cette intention (au-delà des critères académiques classiques)

  • une lettre de recommandation

Informations diverses :


Date limite de candidature : 22 novembre 2026

Core Responsibilities

Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. jobs.title: Account Executive - NL Region
jobs.description:
Account Executive - NL Region

Dit is Shiftbase

Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn.


Wat ga je doen?

Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten.

Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort.

Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee.

Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan.

Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek.

Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar.


Wie ben jij?

Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen.

Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre.

Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech.

Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan.

Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest.

Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast 25 vakantiedagen, een flexibele regeling voor thuis en op kantoor werken, een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding).

De werksfeer? Ontspannen, met gratis lunch, bootcamp op donderdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en kwartaal-BBQ's.

Hoe werken we samen?

De eerste 3 maanden verwachten we een hogere aanwezigheid op kantoor in Zoetermeer. Logisch: je wilt het team, het product en de klant snel doorgronden, en dat gaat nu eenmaal sneller als je er bent. Na je onboarding werken we meer hybride.

Woon je op maximaal anderhalf uur reisafstand? Dan verwachten we je minimaal één keer per week op kantoor, op dinsdag of donderdag. In de praktijk gaan we hier flexibel mee om zodra het vertrouwen er is. Woon je dichterbij of heb je geen probleem met wat meer reistijd? Elke dag op kantoor is natuurlijk ook gewoon mogelijk. Daarnaast is er de hub in Amsterdam waar je terecht kunt.

Waarom Shiftbase?

Je verkoopt geen vaag platform dat niemand begrijpt. Shiftbase is marktleider in Nederland en groeit hard in Duitsland. Een product dat 10.000+ bedrijven dagelijks gebruiken omdat het hun werk simpelweg makkelijker maakt. Dat merk je in elk salesgesprek: klanten snappen de waarde, de use case is herkenbaar en de feedback is positief.

Tegelijkertijd zijn we geen logge olietanker. Met 85+ collega's ben je geen nummer, want wat jij doet heeft directe impact op de koers van het bedrijf. Maar we zijn wél groot en stabiel genoeg om je een serieuze carrière te bieden. Geen start-up-roulette, maar een bewezen business met internationale groeiambities waar jij onderdeel van wordt.

Interesse?

Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Jurrien Strobel via Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow Sales Mid fulltime fixed term Zoetermeer, Zuid-Holland, Netherlands

jobs.title: Product Owner Core Systems
jobs.description:
Product Owner Core Systems

Over Veloretti

Veloretti is een design-led lifestylemerk uit Amsterdam, ontstaan vanuit een heldere visie op hoe mensen zich door de stad bewegen. We ontwerpen fietsen en e-bikes die passen bij het moderne stadsleven: functioneel, doordacht en met veel aandacht voor design, detail en gebruik. Het product staat centraal, maar het merk gaat verder dan mobiliteit alleen. Veloretti beweegt zich op het snijvlak van design, lifestyle en stedelijke cultuur.

Sinds 2022 horen we bij Pon.Bike. Met het oog op onze groei bouwen we aan de teams en cultuur voor de volgende fase van Veloretti.

De rol

Als Product Owner Core Systems ben je verantwoordelijk voor de belangrijkste business- en operations-applicaties zoals het ERP-systeem en het Dealer Portal. Je combineert in deze functie de strategische doorontwikkeling met het dagelijkse management van de applicaties. Dankzij je hands-on ervaring in de applicaties en je goede analytische vaardigheden vertaal je de business behoefte naar goede oplossingen die onze externe development partners kunnen realiseren.

Wat je doet

  • Beheer en prioriteer de backlog: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de backlog van het ERP-systeem, het Dealer Portal en aangrenzende integraties en applicaties. Je vindt daarbij de balans tussen business value, technische haalbaarheid, effort en toekomstvastheid.

  • Vertaal businessbehoeften naar oplossingen: Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders en vertaalt functionele wensen naar een goed solution design en user stories. Je adviseert bovendien over verbeteringen in processen en IT-architectuur.

  • Operationeel applicatiebeheer: Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor het dagelijks beheer van de toegewezen core applicaties. Je faciliteert de operatie door processen optimaal te configureren, gebruikersomgevingen te beheren en applicatie-issues effectief op te lossen.

  • Stuur externe ontwikkelpartners aan: Je leidt de samenwerking met onze IT-leveranciers om met het beschikbare budget de backlog zo efficiënt mogelijk te prioriteren

  • Werk projectmatig en gestructureerd: Je analyseert de operationele- en business processen van je interne klant, brengt risico's in kaart en plant zorgvuldig om de voortgang en afhankelijkheden te coördineren.


Wie we zoeken

We zoeken een analytisch sterke professional die zich net zo comfortabel voelt bij strategische procesarchitectuur als bij hands-on systeemconfiguratie. Je bezit de rust en het overzicht om complexe IT-vraagstukken te doorgronden, die goed uitgewerkt bij de externe development teams te beleggen en hebt de daadkracht om oplossingen zelfstandig te implementeren. Je bent communicatief sterk en daagt de business constructief uit om tot een goede oplossing te komen.

Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner, Business Analyst of Applicatiemanager, bij voorkeur binnen een e-commerce of multichannel consumentenmerk.

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau met een sterk ontwikkeld analytisch vermogen.

  • Ervaring met ERP-systemen en de bijbehorende processen en integraties; kennis van Odoo is een sterke pré.

  • Ervaring met het runnen van e-commerce backend-platformen, specifiek gericht op de inrichting en configuratie van processen.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en/of Engels.

  • Ervaring met agile werken of relevante projectmanagement-certificeringen zijn een pré.

Wat we bieden

Een rol met impact binnen een internationaal team dat bouwt aan de volgende fase van het merk.

En verder, concreet:

  • Een Veloretti Electric Two

  • Een passend salaris afgestemd op jouw ervaring

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling

  • Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget

  • Een gezonde lunch op kantoor tegen een kleine bijdrage

  • Een flexibele hybride werkregeling

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer

De uitdaging

Onze klant ontwikkelt high-tech embedded systemen die extreem betrouwbaar, veilig en performant moeten zijn. Je werkt in een omgeving waar innovatie de standaard is en waar jouw code direct invloed heeft op hardware, sensoren, controllers en real-time verwerking. We zoeken engineers die met plezier de diepte ingaan: van low-level drivers tot robust architecture en van integratie tot performance-optimalisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Embedded Software Engineer werk je via GradeMatch binnen een multidisciplinair engineeringteam dat software, elektronica en systeemarchitectuur combineert. Je ontwikkelt embedded software in C en C++, analyseert hardware-interactie, werkt met RTOS-omgevingen en draagt bij aan nieuwe en bestaande modules. Je krijgt te maken met complexe systemen, nieuwe productfeatures, protocollen, edge computing, testscenario’s en integratie met high-end apparatuur.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je implementeert embedded softwaremodules in C en C++ volgens hoge kwaliteitseisen en werkt aan drivers, interfaces, communicatiestromen en configuratiecomponenten. Je stelt duidelijke requirements op en denkt actief mee over designkeuzes, terwijl je samen met andere engineers high-level en low-level architectuurvoorstellen uitwerkt. Daarnaast test en review je code op betrouwbaarheid, performance en stabiliteit en werk je nauw samen met hardware engineers om een correcte integratie te waarborgen. Je begeleidt de live-gang, validatie en nazorg binnen de embedded omgeving en documenteert code, flows, architectuur en testresultaten zorgvuldig.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.500 - €6.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Uitdagende projecten bij een high-tech klant via GradeMatch

  • Opleidingen, begeleiding en technische sparringpartners

  • Hybride werken mogelijk

  • Mogelijkheden tot specialisatie (RTOS, C++, architectuur, security, Linux internals)

Wat het jou oplevert

jobs.title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior HPC Cluster Engineer

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM.

  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

Senior Applied AI Solutions Engineer

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

AI is moving faster than any single product team can track. Nebius is expanding across serverless, databases, MLflow, MLOps, Physical AI, and HCLS — and customers arriving with complex, real-world ML workloads need more than documentation. This role exists to close that gap: someone who can prototype what's possible, accelerate customers through their first 90 days, and feed hard-won field insight back into the product roadmap.
This role sits at the intersection of deep ML engineering and product impact. You'll spend roughly half your time in the field — helping new customers move from POC to production, running technical onboarding, and working hands-on through their ML stack. The other half you'll spend building — prototyping applied AI use cases that show what's possible on the platform, going deep on emerging techniques before they're mainstream, and turning that expertise into concrete product direction.
This is not a presales role. You get your hands dirty every day.

What success looks like in 12 months

  • The product and sales teams have a library of working, polished demos they reach for on calls
  • Enterprise customers you've touched have meaningfully faster time-to-value than those you haven't
  • At least 2–3 product changes were shipped because of feedback you originated

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build prototypes and demos across the product portfolio — serverless inference, databases, MLflow, MLOps, and vertical use cases in Physical AI and HCLS — that become assets for sales, product, and engineering teams
  • Support new customers hands-on through POC design, technical onboarding, and validation; act as the bridge between their ML team and the platform during the critical first months

This role is a crucial bridge between identifying customer security requirements and implementing best-in-class, enterprise-grade solutions. You will be responsible for defining the criteria, researching the market, and executing technical validation for all major security tooling and services adopted by the company.

jobs.description:
Product Manager - Anti Fraud

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We run a large-scale GPU cloud and AI infrastructure platform. Fraud and abuse — stolen payment cards, fake sign-ups, compute mining, credential abuse, and coordinated free-tier exploitation — directly threaten platform economics, capacity availability for legitimate customers, and our standing with payment providers and cloud partners.

As Product Manager, Anti-Fraud, you own the product roadmap for the systems that detect, prevent, and respond to fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle — from onboarding and payment through to ongoing consumption. You sit at the intersection of Trust & Safety, Payments/Billing, Risk, Data Science, and Product Engineering, and you balance two goals in constant tension: stop bad actors and keep friction near zero for real customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the end-to-end anti-fraud product roadmap: signup/KYC checks, payment fraud detection, account takeover protection, and compute-abuse (e.g., crypto mining, resource reselling) prevention.
  • Own the rules and risk-scoring surfaces — the tooling that lets analysts and data scientists define, test, and deploy detection rules and ML models with clear guardrails and audit trails.
  • Own the manual review and case-management experience for the Trust & Safety operations team, including queues, evidence views, and action workflows (block, limit, step-up verification, release).
  • Own customer-facing friction points — verification flows, step-up challenges, and appeals — designed to minimize false positives and protect the legitimate user experience.
  • Identify fraud and abuse incidents early — define the signals, alerts, and thresholds that surface incidents before they scale, and own the detection surface that flags them.
  • Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems, capturing root causes and turning each finding into concrete improvements to detection rules, models, and the roadmap.
  • Ensure timely response to active incidents — drive fast triage, clear ownership, and mitigation, working alongside Trust & Safety, Engineering, and Data Science to contain impact.
  • Write clear PRDs and specs that translate fuzzy risk problems into shippable engineering and data-science work.
  • Partner with Analytics team on detection models — defining the problem, labels, and success criteria, and deciding where rules vs. ML are the right tool.
  • Run experiments and monitor rollouts, watching both fraud-catch metrics and false-positive / customer-friction impact.
  • Work with Legal/Compliance to keep detection and enforcement aligned with payment-network rules, KYC/AML expectations, and data-privacy requirements.
  • Track and report on fraud loss, chargeback rate, false-positive rate, review throughput, and time-to-detection.

We expect you to have:

  • Proven product management experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, SQL or equivalent, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs and metrics.
  • Ability to make decisions under ambiguity and to balance security, business, and customer-experience priorities.
  • Solid collaboration with engineering and data science; you can hold a technical conversation about signals, features, and model behavior.
  • Exposure to cloud, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or infrastructure products.
  • Understanding payment fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, or device/network signals (fingerprinting, velocity, IP reputation).

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • Familiarity with ML-based detection systems and their operational lifecycle (drift, retraining, monitoring).
  • Experience with abuse patterns specific to compute or GPU platforms (mining, credential stuffing, free-tier farming).

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:

OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

  • Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

  • Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

  • Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.

MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

  • Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

  • Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

  • Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.

BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

  • Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

  • Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

  • Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.

TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

  • Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

  • Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

  • Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

  • 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

  • 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

  • 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

  • 🧭 Judgment on unattributable spend: You have built and defended investment cases for brand, community, content, or similar spend that will never attribute cleanly to a closed deal.

  • 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔄 PLG + SLG fluency: You have deep experience across both product-led and sales-led demand motions rather than primarily one.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer-focused environment: You have worked at a community-led, open-source, or developer-focused product company.

  • 🧪 Incrementality & experimentation: You have exposure to incrementality testing, holdout design, or marketing mix modeling.

  • 🛠️ Marketing & RevOps tooling: You have experience consuming data from tools such as HubSpot or Marketo, GA4, attribution platforms, and Salesforce.

  • 📋 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity, or multi-stakeholder environments.

  • 🧑‍🔬 Data self-sufficiency: You are comfortable using SQL and building your own views in tools such as Looker, Metabase, or Hex rather than waiting on a Data team.

  • ⚙️ Relevant SaaS domain experience: You have worked in workflow automation, developer tools, or infrastructure SaaS.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll own the financial view of one of the most important joins in our growth engine: where community, product-led adoption, and enterprise demand generation meet. You’ll work closely with Marketing leadership and counterpart FP&A Managers covering the PLG and SLG bottom of funnel, giving you visibility across the full commercial plan and real influence over how we allocate one of our largest discretionary investments.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where finance is expected to help shape decisions, not simply report on them. As n8n expands the opportunity around AI agent orchestration and helps businesses unlock measurable ROI through automation, you’ll help build the planning discipline, investment frameworks, and automation-first finance practices that support our next stage of growth.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Technical Program Manager III, Automotive

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

At Mapbox, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) ensure successful, on-time launches for Mapbox's key customers by turning complex needs into realized value. TPMs independently develop and execute strategies to maximize customer satisfaction, while minimizing thrash in changes to priorities and roadmap. They provide high-judgement updates to Mapbox leaders–keeping them informed on progress while handling the day-to-day operations independently.

 

What You'll Do

Mapbox is seeking a Technical Program Manager III (TPM) to lead complex, high-visibility post-sales programs for our large automotive customers. This is a high-impact role in a dynamic environment where you will work both independently and collaboratively alongside a high-performing team of TPMs to deliver successful customer launches. You will drive operational rigor within your programs, acting as a key driver of accountability and consistent, high-quality delivery across cross-functional teams within Mapbox.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex automotive customer launches and programs, serving as the main point of contact for program health, timelines, and execution

  • Be the primary interface between our key automotive customers and our internal teams, advocating for mutual success by championing the needs of our customers with internal teams (including leadership, product management, engineering, sales, technical support), and representing Mapbox to our customers

  • Define success for our customer programs, including how we measure it, and how we get there.

  • Align with Product and Engineering to translate and prioritize customer feedback into actionable insights and roadmap clarity.

  • Set and uphold a high quality bar, working with technical support, product and engineering teams to ensure effective prioritization and resolution of quality issues, and to synthesize and address overarching quality concerns.

  • Lead senior-level discussions - both internally and externally - around delivery timelines, trade-offs, scope, and business impact.

  • Provide calm and decisive program leadership during high-pressure situations with customers.

  • Provide clear & concise reporting to program key stakeholders and track and manage and report on program risks, working with customers and internal teams to mitigate and/or and escalate for resolution.

  • Lead or contribute to internal initiatives to improve internal processes across the TPM and Mapbox organizations.

  • Develop a deep knowledge of Mapbox products and services in order to steer technical discussions and build trust with our customers

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise software implementations in a highly regulated post-sales or professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated success in the automotive industry managing scope, SOW execution, change management, and high-impact customer escalations.

  • Proven ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments from kickoff through production launch.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 20%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Delivery-Oriented Leader: You are accountable for outcomes and not just coordination. You build structure in ambiguity and create operational discipline that enables predictable success.

  • Customer-Centric Operator: You proactively represent the customer internally and ensure their business objectives drive implementation priorities.

  • Effective Communicator: You engage effectively across audiences from developers to senior executives with clarity, confidence, and precision.

  • Technically Fluent: You understand cloud architectures, API/SDK integrations, and enterprise technical ecosystems deeply enough to anticipate risk and guide execution credibly.

  • Cross-Functional Influencer: You navigate matrixed organizations effectively aligning Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Executive Leadership to deliver customer outcomes.

  • Knowledge of Automotive SPICE is desirable

Core Working Hours

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

  • Standby / On-Call: As needed with ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 30%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. 

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.
