jobs.description:
Account Lead Mid-Market

Account Lead, Mid-Market

Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

Your Mission:

You’ll join the Client Management team as an Account Lead for the Mid-Market segment, with a clear focus on winning new clients and accelerating sustainable revenue growth.

You’ll identify and develop high-potential prospects, build a strong and well-qualified pipeline, and lead opportunities through the full business development cycle. Working across ClearBank, you’ll bring together the right expertise to understand prospective clients’ needs, shape compelling solutions and convert opportunities into successful new relationships.

This includes

  • Developing and executing a focused business development plan for the Mid-Market segment, aligned with agreed commercial priorities and target client profiles.

  • Identifying and targeting prospective clients through structured market mapping, research, referrals, networking, industry events and proactive outreach.

  • Building and maintaining a healthy, well-qualified pipeline of new business opportunities, with clear next steps, accurate forecasting and disciplined progression through each stage.

  • Creating and executing account-based prospecting plans for priority organisations, engaging relevant decision-makers and building relationships across the buying group.

  • Leading the end-to-end new business cycle, from initial engagement and discovery through solution development, commercial negotiation and contract completion.

  • Conducting effective discovery to understand each prospect’s strategy, business model, customer needs and commercial priorities, translating these into relevant opportunities for ClearBank.

  • Developing compelling propositions that clearly articulate ClearBank’s value and provide informed perspectives on how prospective clients could achieve their objectives.

  • Collaborating across Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and other relevant teams to assess opportunities, shape viable proposals and progress new business efficiently.

  • Maintaining accurate and timely opportunity information, using pipeline data and market insight to support forecasting, prioritisation and commercial decision-making.

  • Representing ClearBank externally at relevant industry events and forums, using these opportunities to create relationships, generate leads and strengthen the Mid-Market proposition.

What we’re looking for (Skills & Experience)

This role would suit a business development focused professional with a strong record of identifying, developing and converting new client opportunities. You’ll be comfortable creating opportunities rather than relying solely on inbound demand, and able to manage complex sales cycles involving multiple senior stakeholders.

In addition:

  • Demonstrable experience of winning new clients through proactive business development, prospecting and relationship creation.

  • A strong track record of building, qualifying and converting sales pipelines in a complex B2B environment.

  • Experience managing the full new business development cycle, from market mapping and initial outreach through discovery, proposal development, negotiation and close.

  • Ability to develop clear target-client and account plans, prioritising activity according to strategic fit, client need and commercial potential.

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to uncover client challenges and translate them into relevant commercial propositions.

  • Experience building relationships with senior decision makers and navigating multiple stakeholders within prospective client organisations.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including the ability to qualify opportunities, focus effort effectively and balance growth objectives with risk considerations.

  • Clear communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex banking or payments propositions in an accessible and compelling way.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and operational stakeholders throughout the sales process.

  • Relevant knowledge of banking, payments, fintech or financial services would be advantageous.

What success looks like in the role

  • A strong, credible and well-qualified pipeline is developed and maintained against agreed Mid-Market priorities.

  • Priority prospects are engaged through consistent, targeted and insight-led business development activity.

  • Forecasts and pipeline information are accurate, current and supported by clear evidence and next actions.

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Solutions Consultant

As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing

  • Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
  • Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
  • Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
  • Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
  • Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
  • Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
  • Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
  • Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
  • A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
  • Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
  • Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
  • A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
  • Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
  • Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

  • Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
  • A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
  • Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning

Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

  • Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

  • Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

  • Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

  • Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

  • Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

  • Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

  • Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

  • The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

  • Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

  • Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others.

What we offer

  • Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

  • Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

  • Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

  • Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

Data/ML engineer, fusion data

Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets.

  • Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection.

  • Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team.

  • Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels.

  • Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

  • Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

  • Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

  • Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

  • Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

  • The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Meewerkstage: Communicatie

Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal.

Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • verhalen en ontwikkelingen ophalen bij collega’s uit verschillende delen van de organisatie;

  • helpen bij het plannen, voorbereiden en publiceren van content (tekst, video, offline materialen);

  • ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom grote interne bijeenkomsten;

  • nieuwe formats en creatieve manieren bedenken om verhalen binnen Voortman te vertellen;

  • kijken hoe we sterke interne content slim kunnen doorvertalen naar externe middelen voor bijvoorbeeld employer branding;

Je doet dit natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met het communicatieteam en onze collega’s van Marketing. Binnen het bredere team zijn verschillende specialisten aanwezig, onder andere op het gebied van foto, video en contentcreatie. Daardoor krijg je de kans om met verschillende disciplines samen te werken én veel kanten van het communicatievak te ontdekken.

Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën aan te dragen, initiatief te nemen en dingen uit te proberen. En doordat je voor je content met collega’s uit de hele organisatie samenwerkt, zit je echt centraal in Voortman. Een veelzijdige communicatiestage waarin je veel van de organisatie ziet, veel mensen leert kennen en vooral ook veel zelf gaat maken.


Wij vragen

  • Hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van communicatie, creative business, journalistiek of vergelijkbaar;

  • Je hebt een professionele, pakkende schrijfstijl en vindt het leuk om content te maken;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, proactief en stapt gemakkelijk op collega’s af;

  • Je hebt gevoel voor verschillende doelgroepen en denkt graag na over hoe je hen het beste bereikt.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

Stage Software Development

Stage Software Development 

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou!


Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access,  geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld.


Bouw jij mee? 

Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en  ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. 


Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: 

  • Backend development; 

  • Frontend development; 

  • Embedded Software Development; 

  • DevOps; 

  • Security; 

  • Software testing. 


Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: 

  • Python; 

  • C++;

  • Rust; 

  • Angular; 

  • Typescript; 

  • Playwright; 

  • Zabbix; 

  • Linux; 

  • MariaDB;

  • Kubernetes; 

  • SALT. 

Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. 


Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten?

  • Studio for e-mail

Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren.

  • Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development)

Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager.

  • Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing)

Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline.

Hier herken jij jezelf in 

Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. 


Dit hebben wij jou te bieden 

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding;

  • Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën;

  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie.

jobs.title: Compliance & Risk Lead (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Compliance & Risk Lead (Maternity Cover)

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 300 territories globally.

The Role:

As Compliance & Risk Lead, you are a key member of Paddle’s compliance team, reporting to our VP, Compliance. You work closely with legal, product, and operational teams to ensure Paddle remains compliant with global payments and fintech regulations as we scale rapidly.

The Paddle compliance function is critical to our operations and growth, enabling innovation while maintaining trust with customers and regulators. You lead the compliance team and collaborate across teams, bringing expertise in payments compliance, risk management, and reporting. You are instrumental in building robust systems to track, analyze, and report on compliance, ensuring Paddle stays ahead in a dynamic regulatory landscape.

The role is based in the UK but global in scope, reflecting Paddle’s international reach.

What you'll do:

You will partner with our Compliance, legal and other teams across Paddle to integrate compliance into our operations, with a heightened focus on building scalable monitoring and reporting:

  • Team leadership: Hire, onboard, and manage compliance professionals, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team to support Paddle’s global compliance needs.

  • Payments compliance: Develop and refine compliance policies and procedures to ensure adherence to global card scheme rules, consumer protection laws and payments regulation (as applicable).

  • Compliance monitoring: Design and oversee simple tech-enabled monitoring programs to track compliance with internal policies and external regulations, using data-driven tools to identify trends and potential risks proactively.

  • Reporting: Deliver compliance reporting for internal stakeholders at all levels (e.g. senior leadership, the Board, product teams) and external regulators, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity to demonstrate Paddle’s regulatory adherence.

  • Risk management: Develop and manage Paddle’s enterprise risk management program, collaborating with teams across the business to identify risks, embed controls and report on their effectiveness.

  • Regulatory research: Work with the legal team to stay ahead of evolving payments, consumer and fintech regulations, advising on their impact and integrating findings into monitoring and reporting frameworks.

  • Incident response: Lead investigations into high-risk complaints and/or compliance breaches, coordinating with legal and operational teams to resolve issues, and produce detailed incident reports for internal review and regulatory submission as needed.

We'd love to hear from you:

  • You have 6-8 years of compliance experience, ideally in payments and/or in fast-growing businesses, with a proven ability to implement and manage scalable monitoring and reporting systems.

  • You have deep expertise in data protection, card scheme rules and payments regulation (e.g., PSD2, AML/KYC) and hands-on experience in fintech or SaaS environments.

  • You’ve worked in a high-growth scale-up, building compliance frameworks that emphasize real-time monitoring and detailed reporting to support rapid expansion.

  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to distill compliance data into concise, actionable insights for diverse audiences—from engineers to regulators.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing proactive monitoring with the ability to respond swiftly to competing demands.

  • You’re detail-oriented, with a passion for ensuring compliance is not just met but demonstrably provable.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and enhanced parental leave. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Job Title: Senior Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Senior Business Systems Administrator will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Enterprise Business Systems Team - leading strategy, planning, implementation, advanced configuration, and business process optimization efforts across a set of G&A and Finance systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for the strategy, development, and architecture of systems aligned to a business function. Specifically, you will:

  • Define and maintain RACI (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) matrices for all business systems, ensuring clear ownership and accountability

Senior People Business Partner

ROLE: Senior People Business Partner
LOCATION: United States - REMOTE

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue, one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won: the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue, and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior People Business Partner (Senior PBP) aligned to our Customer organization, you are the strategic people advisor to its leaders, embedded deeply in the business as an integral partner in how the organization is built, led and grown. You independently own the people partnership for your function and the outcomes that come with it: the people strategy, the risk, and the quality of every program that touches your teams. Your time goes to advising, calibrating, and solving, and to spotting issues early and shaping values-aligned interventions before they become problems. You'll take on our most complex people matters, set the standard for how the PBP team works, and help develop partners earlier in their careers. You'll regularly partner with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Benefits, Legal, and L&D.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

  • Embed in the business. Join your leaders' operating rhythm, including staff meetings, planning and reviews, so people strategy is part of how decisions get made. Learn the language, goals and metrics of the function you support and speak them fluently.
  • Own the partnership. Independently own embedded strategic partnership for your function. Identify employee relations and performance trends across functions, and shape proactive, values-aligned interventions before they become issues.
  • Talent strategy & workforce architecture. Partner closely with department leaders to design and execute forward-looking talent strategies, including workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.
  • Trusted advisor & coach. Act as a trusted partner to executives, directors, and front-line managers on team design, growth, and people decisions. Guide leaders at all levels through performance management cases, and build frameworks other partners can reuse.
  • Lead change. Provide expert guidance on large-scale change, including business transformation, rapid scaling, and restructuring. Consult on it, execute it, and build it as a repeatable system. Identify organization design issues leaders may miss and address the structural cause, not the symptom.
  • Lead calibration. Run talent calibration and review conversations for your entire population, lead promotion calibration, manage leadership communications, and make sure growth and development stay a priority for managers.
  • Drive engagement. Review engagement results with leaders at every level, align on action plans, and make sure they get done, including working directly with front-line managers.
  • Own employee relations. Lead our most complex employee relations matters, including investigations, recommended outcomes and terminations, with a focus on fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with our values. Say the uncomfortable thing in the room when the data supports it, and coach other partners through their cases.
  • Evidence over ego. Analyze workforce trends and HRIS metrics to recommend data-driven action plans that improve engagement and retention. Build business cases for people initiatives in the function's own financial and operational terms. Bring data to every interaction and connect it to a narrative that gets people to move together. Seek and give feedback, and share lessons learned so the whole function improves.
  • Use AI with intent. Use AI tools in your daily work, advise on policy, privacy and ethical guardrails, and help shape how AI fits into our people strategy.
  • Partner with L&D. Use data to identify and drive learning and development opportunities, and build programs the business can scale without you in the room.
  • Mentor the team. Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level PBPs on employee relations, advisory skills and project delivery, and teach them to build a case for change from evidence rather than instinct.
  • Land people projects. Own and drive org-wide employee relations and performance projects and cross-team people projects, and make sure they are operationalized in the business, not only launched.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're a credible, business-minded People Partner, embedded within the business, who can build trust with a front-line manager and a senior executive on the same day. You give candid advice, balance empathy with sound judgment, and make good decisions under pressure. You're sought out before major decisions because your recommendations are built around what leaders and employees actually experience. You've done this at depth before and you want to be the person others on the team learn from. You also delegate well and are comfortable with a model that separates strategic ownership from administration. Modeling and upholding our five values (Move as One, Evidence Over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer Inspired) is expected at every level. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this role offers real scope and visibility.

THE TEAM

Our PBPs and Shared Services work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

We are results-oriented and warm, we take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.

THE SKILL SET

  • 6+ years of progressive HR experience, including 4+ years as an HR Business Partner or equivalent supporting a technology or SaaS organization.
  • Experience partnering with department leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.
  • Strong ability to advise leaders from directors to the executive team on team design, growth, and people decisions, and to shape people strategy across functions.
  • Proven record leading leaders through large-scale organizational change, including business transformation, rapid scaling, or restructuring.
  • Experience guiding leaders through complex performance management cases and building frameworks others reuse.
  • Facilitation experience running talent and promotion calibration, and reinforcing growth and development with managers.
  • Demonstrated depth in employee relations: leading complex investigations, recommending outcomes, and executing terminations, with a focus on fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with company values.
  • Experience analyzing engagement and workforce data, building business cases, and driving action plans through completion.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other HR practitioners.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your work, and sound judgment on policy, privacy and ethical risk.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and discretion with confidential information.
  • Experience supporting Customer Success, Support, or Services teams, or Sales teams is preferred
  • Experience with HiBob or a similar HRIS, plus Google Workspace is preferred
  • Experience with global mobility, supporting teams internationally, engagement survey action planning, or high-growth and private-equity-backed environments is preferred
  • HR certification (SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR) is preferred

Ready to join?

jobs.title: Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)

Über uns

CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.

Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.

Deine Rolle

Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.

Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.

Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.

Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Backlog und Tickets

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

  • Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

  • Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

Konzeption

  • Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

  • Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

  • Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

Planung und Steuerung

  • Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

  • Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

  • Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

Schnittstellen

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

  • Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

  • Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

  • Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

  • Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

Deine ersten Monate

  • In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

  • Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

  • Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

  • Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

  • Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

  • Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.

  • Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.

  • Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch.

Was wir dir bieten

About Firstwork

Firstwork exists so that every frontline worker gets the same personal, 24/7 support in starting and staying in a job that a senior professional gets from a dedicated recruiter, made affordable by AI.

We're an applied AI company running frontline workforce operations for staffing firms and large employers of hourly and shift workers. Our software does the work that sits today with recruiters, compliance teams and outsourced back offices, from a worker's first application into the job itself. We support 150,000 workers a month across more than 80 countries, for customers including Job&Talent, Deel, Wonolo, BGSF, ProLink and Multiplier. Our Series A was led by Earlybird Venture Capital alongside Gradient Ventures and Y Combinator, and we're growing our team in London.

 

The role

Help UK and European recruitment agencies get workers into shifts faster and keep them working as rules change, with AI that does the work their back-office and compliance teams carry today. You'll join our UK sales team early and help build Firstwork's European business from the ground floor.

You'll sell to Managing Directors, CEOs, Operations Directors and Heads of Compliance, Onboarding or Vetting at UK agencies across industrial, driving and logistics, healthcare and care, and hospitality, then into major European markets. What we're looking for

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to own the design, build, and maintenance of integrations between Workday and our wider systems landscape (TA, Reward, Payroll, Absence, Finance, and third-party tools). You'll work alongside the People Technology and module teams to keep data flowing accurately and securely across the platform and help extend Workday's capabilities beyond its native functionality.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Design, build, and support Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Workday APIs (SOAP/REST)

  • Partner with module teams (HCM, Absence, Compensation) and system owners (Finance, IT, Workforce Management) to gather integration requirements

Minimum Requirements

Nice to Have

Why this Role

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO.

You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. jobs.title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines

L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur.



Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire.

Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F.

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison.

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

  • Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
  • Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
  • Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.
  • Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés.
  • Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture.
  • Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif.
  • Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents.
  • Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
  • Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.


Profil :

  • Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines.
  • Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire, obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration.
  • Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire.
  • Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales.
  • Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.
  • Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers.
  • Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH.
  • Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles.
  • Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout.
  • Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive.


Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ?

  • Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain, au cœur de la vie de la Maison.
  • L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours.
  • Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation.
  • Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur.
  • Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève.
  • La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage.


Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison.

jobs.title: Content & Social Growth Manager:in (80–100 %)
jobs.description:
Content & Social Growth Manager:in (80–100 %)

Was bluu bewegt

Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen.
Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.

Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich.
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

  • Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

  • Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

  • Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

  • E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle.
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

  • neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

  • Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

  • neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

  • nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

  • Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

  • Du filmst und schneidest selbst, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

  • erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

  • Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

  • Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

  • echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

  • ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

  • Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

  • ein Büro mitten in Zürich, Homeoffice bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche

  • bis zu zwei Wochen pro Jahr arbeitest du, von wo du möchtest

  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem ganzen Team, auch bei neuen Produktideen

  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen: Wenn etwas Sinn macht, probieren wir es aus

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten)
Erzähl uns:

  1. was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

  2. Warum genau du perfekt für die Stelle passt

  3. wo du aktuell den grössten Hebel für bluu siehst

  4. eine konkrete Content-Idee für @bluuwash

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

Wichtig: Verlinke dein Video oder dein Portfolio direkt in deinem CV, zum Beispiel über YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive oder deine eigene Website.

Wir suchen keine Person, die Content nur plant.
Wir suchen jemanden, der einen Trend morgens sieht, ihn am Nachmittag umsetzt und am nächsten Tag weiss, ob er funktioniert hat.

We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind A1.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

jobs.title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description:
Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026

Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.
