jobs.title: Chief of Staff (f/m/d)
Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager (EMEA)

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.

You will:

• Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.

• Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.

• Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer.

• Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope.

• Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery.

• Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support.

• Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio.

• Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures.

Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management

• Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts.

• Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority.

• Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff.

• Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits.

• Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows.

Requirements

You Have

• At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.

• A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread.

• Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and keep stakeholders aligned through go-live.

• Proven ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and maintain clarity under ambiguity.

Nice to Have

• Technical fluency sufficient to direct integration specialists and translate between technical and business stakeholders.

• Exposure to ecommerce, product discovery, LLMs and familiarity with concepts like catalog data feeds, integrations and APIs.

• Experience coordinating implementations that span internal teams, customer resources, and third-party partners.

Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

🏥 Company sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

Customer Success at voize is proactive. We help customers succeed in a smart, repeatable way, without losing judgment or humanity. You’ll work with a high-volume portfolio of mid-market and SME customers and ensure voize is adopted quickly, sustainably and with real impact in their daily care workflows.

  • Own the end-to-end rollout and success of 30–50 customers

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

    • Have a strong can-do mentality and take ownership naturally

    • Enjoy working with data, dashboards and signals

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

jobs.description:
Field Accound Manager Germany North (m/w/d)

Account Manager General Business Nord (m/w/d)
Remote | Wohnort in NRW bzw. Norddeutschland | Vertriebsgebiet Norddeutschland inkl. NRW | Vollzeit | Festanstellung

Über Everfield

Everfield ist auf den Erwerb, die Entwicklung und den Ausbau von europäischen Software-Unternehmen in unterschiedlichen Märkten spezialisiert. Wir stellen unseren Unternehmen jegliche strategischen Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um auf die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu gelangen. Unsere Mission ist es, ambitionierte Visionen zu verwirklichen, nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern und neue Chancen im europäischen Software-Ökosystem zu erschließen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem bewahren ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte, um sich gezielt auf ihre Kernkompetenzen zu konzentrieren: die Entwicklung innovativer Produkte und die umfassende Betreuung ihrer Kunden. Everfield bietet dabei gezielte Unterstützung in den Bereichen Personalgewinnung und HR sowie Zugang zu einem Expertenteam, das auf den Aufbau und das Wachstum europäischer B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen spezialisiert ist und in finanziellen sowie operativen Belangen berät. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2022 ist Everfield in 7 Ländern präsent – und wächst stetig weiter.

Über helloTESS!

Cloudbasiert, flexibel und intuitiv – helloTESS! erfüllt die Anforderungen sowohl der klassischen Gastronomie als auch der Betriebsgastronomie und Hotellerie. Mit unserer cloudbasierten Lösung digitalisieren wir Bestell- und Bezahlprozesse, schaffen maximale Flexibilität und ermöglichen individuelle Erweiterungen, die sich an die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden anpassen. So machen wir Gastronomie smarter, effizienter und zukunftssicher.

helloTESS! gehört seit 2024 zu Everfield. Der Hauptsitz von helloTESS! befindet sich in München.

Die TESSERO GmbH entwickelt mit helloTESS! moderne iPad- und Cloud-Lösungen für Gastronomie, Hotellerie und Gemeinschaftsverpflegung. Zur weiteren Stärkung unseres Vertriebs suchen wir für den Bereich General Business Nord einen engagierten Account Manager, der vollständig remote arbeitet, idealerweise in NRW lebt und unser Vertriebsgebiet in Norddeutschland inklusive NRW aufbaut und betreut.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Manager General Business Nord bist du verantwortlich für den aktiven Ausbau unseres Kunden- und Partnernetzwerks im Gastronomieumfeld. Du identifizierst neue Potenziale, entwickelst bestehende Accounts weiter und überzeugst Kunden mit passenden Lösungen aus dem gesamten Portfolio der TESSERO GmbH.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Akquise neuer Kunden und Kooperationspartner im Gastronomieumfeld

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Accounts in Norddeutschland und NRW

  • Analyse von Kundenpotenzialen, Anforderungen und individuellen Bedürfnissen

  • Evaluierung passender Umsetzungsmöglichkeiten auf Basis unseres Produkt- und Leistungsportfolios

  • Erstellung, Nachverfolgung und Verhandlung von Angeboten, Ausschreibungen und Verträgen

  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Verkaufsverhandlungen auf Entscheiderebene

  • Identifikation und Realisierung von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen

  • Verantwortung für quantitative und qualitative Vertriebsziele

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen wie Support, Projektmanagement, Produktmanagement und Geschäftsführung, remote und digital

  • Beobachtung von Trends, Entwicklungen und Neuheiten in der Gastronomie- und POS-Branche

  • Entwicklung zum Branchenexperten für deine Kunden und dein Vertriebsgebiet

Damit überzeugst du uns

Du bist vertriebsstark, kontaktfreudig und hast Freude daran, Kunden aktiv zu gewinnen und langfristig zu entwickeln. Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst die nötige Eigeninitiative mit, um dein Gebiet erfolgreich und eigenständig aus dem Remote-Setup heraus aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Außendienst

  • Vertriebserfahrung in einer artverwandten Branche, zum Beispiel Gastronomie, Hospitality, POS, Payment, Software oder Dienstleistungen

  • Ausgeprägte Vertriebsaffinität und Freude an aktiver Neukundenakquise

  • Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten und hohe Kontaktstärke

  • Souveränität in Verhandlungen und Stresssituationen

  • Sehr gutes Kommunikations- und Präsentationsvermögen in Deutsch

  • Organisationstalent sowie eine eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch im Remote-Umfeld

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung

  • Engagement, Flexibilität und Teamfähigkeit

  • Wohnort in NRW bzw. Norddeutschland

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Norddeutschlands und NRW sowie gelegentlich zu unserem Hauptsitz in München

  • Führerschein Klasse B

Unser Angebot – deine Chance

Bei uns erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Vertriebsaufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, modernen Produkten und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du arbeitest nah am Markt, nah am Kunden und direkt an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Geschäfts in der Region Nord.

  • Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst. Berufserfahrung, eigene Social-Media-Projekte, journalistische Arbeit, Agenturerfahrung oder ein überzeugendes Portfolio sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Der Maschinenraum ist eine neutrale Plattform vom Mittelstand für den Mittelstand mit inzwischen mehr als 70 Familienunternehmen.

Unser Netzwerk lebt von einer Systemlandschaft, die alle Maschinenraum Aktivitäten im Hintergrund trägt: Salesforce, Hivebrite, Zapier, Langdock und Google Workspace bilden das operative Rückgrat unserer täglichen Arbeit. Ein zentraler Baustein ist dabei unsere Maschinenraum Intelligence. Unsere Daten- und Wissensinfrastruktur, die Informationen aus verschiedenen Systemen zusammenführt, analysiert und für unsere Teams nutzbar macht.

Was du bewirkst

Du verantwortest unsere technische Systemlandschaft end-to-end und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung sowie eng mit allen Maschinenraum-Teams zusammen.

Du durchdringst unsere Prozesse fachlich, steuerst sie technisch und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit den Teams weiter. Das bedeutet konkret:

  • Tech Stack, Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du bist Owner unseres Tech Stacks mit “Work Smart” als Leitmotiv. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme Hand in Hand greifen. Du verknüpfst Tools, baust und betreust smarte Automatisierungen sowie Schnittstellen, hältst Prozesse schlank und erleichterst so den Alltag des gesamten Teams.
  • Daten, CRM & Reporting: Du nutzt Salesforce als unser zentrales CRM und als verlässliche Datengrundlage. Du verstehst Datenmodelle, verknüpfst Daten sauber miteinander und baust übersichtliche Dashboards auf, die dem gesamten Team als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen.
  • KI & Wissensmanagement: Du arbeitest explorativ an KI-Lösungen im Rahmen des Maschinenraum Angebots und entwickelst unsere aktuelle Intelligence-Initiative weiter. Dein Ziel: KI verantwortungsvoll einsetzen, um das Wissen in unserem Ökosystem optimal nutzbar zu machen.
  • Evaluation neuer Tools & Technologien: Du prüfst neue Lösungen auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für unsere Teams und begleitest deren Implementierung und Roll-Out. Dabei entwickelst du unseren Tech Stack kontinuierlich weiter.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bist du

Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem kleinen dynamischen Team, in dem jeder anpacken und mitdenken muss. Du hast Interesse an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Daten und Technologie und Freude daran, dich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Dinge praktisch umzusetzen. Außerdem bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Du hast idealerweise 3-5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem Startup-, Scale-up- oder vergleichbaren Umfeld, idealerweise in (Business) Operations, RevOps oder einer systemnahen Rolle.
  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte technische Affinität mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Systeme, Datenstrukturen und Tools einarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hands-on: Du übersetzt zwischen Fachbereich und System, treibst Themen selbstständig sowie strukturiert voran und bringst sie zu Ende.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Tools und Automatisierungen und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Systemen.
  • Du denkst ganzheitlich: Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Tools, Daten, Prozessen und Teams und kannst daraus pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Dashboards und Reporting-Strukturen und verstehst, wie Daten strukturiert und miteinander verknüpft sind.
  • Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und AI-Tools und hast Lust, dich eigenständig in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Neues auszuprobieren.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Ein Plus aber kein Muss: Erste Anknüpfungspunkte mit dem deutschen familiengeführten Mittelstand oder Community-Plattformen (z.B. Hivebrite).

Auch wenn du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, aber neugierig bist und Lust hast zu lernen, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.

Was dich erwartet

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Ownership: Viel Verantwortung und Freiraum, um unsere Systemlandschaft eigenständig zu gestalten, weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu prägen
  • Direkter Draht & kurze Wege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, direkter Austausch und schnelle Entscheidungen
  • Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten
  • Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung
  • Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs
  • Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. Sommerfest & Offsite), Teamtrainings und echtem Raum für persönliches Wachstum
  • Benefits & Auszeit: 30 Urlaubstage, freie Brückentage sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits (z. B. Urban Sports Club, BVG, Aware by Aeon)

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)

Über uns

Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern.

Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten.

Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden.

Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil.

Wir schätzen unsere Traditionen, sind offen für Innovationen und entwickeln uns weiter. Möchtest du mitgestalten?

Zur Stelle

Welche Anlagenstandorte eignen sich für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen? In unserem Projektteam mit fünf bis sechs Kollegen vergleichst du Alternativen und führst technische Anforderungen, Umweltbelange und raumplanerische Gesichtspunkte zu einer fundierten Bewertung zusammen. Damit schaffst du belastbare Grundlagen für Standortentscheidungen und wirkst an der Genehmigungsunterlage mit.

Du übernimmst fachliche Projektaufgaben und entsprechend deiner Erfahrung eigene Teilbereiche. Erfahrene Teammitglieder begleiten deine Einarbeitung und stehen dir als Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Deine Aufgaben

Du vergleichst und bewertest Standortalternativen eigenständig anhand fachlicher und rechtlicher Kriterien. Dabei identifizierst Du Konfliktlagen, bewertest Genehmigungshemmnisse und leitest belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen ab.

Du analysierst und beurteilst komplexe Planungsunterlagen, Fachbeiträge und Geodaten und führst umweltfachliche, raumplanerische, technische und rechtliche Erkenntnisse zu einer konsistenten Gesamtbewertung zusammen.

Du verfasst, strukturierst und prüfst anspruchsvolle Gutachtentexte. Deine Bewertungen, Abwägungen und Schlussfolgerungen begründest Du fachlich fundiert, präzise und nachvollziehbar.

Du beurteilst die Belastbarkeit von Quellen, Daten und fachlichen Argumentationen und stellst sicher, dass Aussagen zwischen unterschiedlichen Fachbeiträgen und über mehrere Prüfebenen hinweg konsistent sind.

Du identifizierst fachliche Widersprüche, methodische Schwächen und offene Fragestellungen, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und koordinierst erforderliche Klärungen mit internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und fachliche Teilbereiche, behältst Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation der Ergebnisse.

Das bringst Du mit

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Umwelt- oder Landschaftsplanung, Geografie, Raumplanung, Bau- oder Umweltingenieurwesen oder Jura, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse, Bewertung oder Begutachtung komplexer Planungs- und Genehmigungsfragen.

Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, umfangreiche und teilweise widersprüchliche Informationen zu strukturieren, kritisch zu bewerten und zu belastbaren Schlussfolgerungen zusammenzuführen.

Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in der fachlichen Textarbeit sowie Erfahrung darin, komplexe Sachverhalte und anspruchsvolle Abwägungen präzise, verständlich und überzeugend zu begründen.

Eine eigenständige, systematische und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit fachlichen Unsicherheiten, Datenlücken und unterschiedlichen Interessenlagen.

Souveräne Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Fragestellungen mit unterschiedlichen Disziplinen und Projektbeteiligten konstruktiv zu klären.

Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift - mindestens B1 Niveau

Das ist darüber hinaus von Vorteil

Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Planungs- und Umweltrecht sowie Erfahrung mit komplexen Genehmigungsverfahren.

Erfahrung mit Projekten im Bereich der Energieinfrastruktur und der Bewertung von Standortalternativen.

Sichere Anwendung von GIS und Erfahrung in der Auswertung und Interpretation räumlicher Daten.

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Koordination von Projektbeteiligten oder in der Qualitätssicherung von Gutachten und Fachbeiträgen.

Kenntnisse planungs- und umweltrechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen, Erfahrung mit Energieinfrastruktur sowie GIS-Kenntnisse.

Das bieten wir Dir

Eine unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit mit einer attraktiven Vergütung

Benefits – Jobticket und monatlich 50 Euro steuerfrei als Debit Card

Zusätzliche Absicherung durch eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung

Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersversorgung und zu Vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

Spannende, abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit echter gesellschaftlicher Wirkung

Ein motiviertes, wertschätzendes Team, das Wert auf vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Teamentwicklung legt

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit hochwertiger Ausstattung – inklusive höhenverstellbarer Schreibtische

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Zukunft

Gemeinsame Erlebnisse bei Firmen-Events

Du hast den Freiraum, dich einzubringen, zu gestalten und Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

So bewirbst du dich

Fühlst du dich angesprochen und konnten wir dein Interesse wecken?

Dann freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen und aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deines gewünschten Arbeitszeitumfangs, deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins über den Button auf dieser Seite.

Für fachliche Fragen steht dir Simone Ackermann (Standortleitung Büro Bonn) unter +49 228 / 8236 9890 zur Verfügung.

Weitere Informationen zu uns: https://www.terra-consulting-gmbh.de

jobs.title: Sr. Business Consultant - Performance Marketing (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sr. Business Consultant - Performance Marketing (w/m/d)

Du möchtest Kund:innen strategisch beraten, nachhaltige Wachstumschancen erschließen und digitale Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich weiterentwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. 🚀

Deine Mission

Als Business Consultant (w/m/d) übernimmst du die strategische Betreuung von Neu- und Bestandskund:innen und agierst als kommunikative Schnittstelle zu internen Fachbereichen. Dein Ziel: Langfristige Kundenbeziehungen stärken und durch datenbasierte Strategien nachhaltiges Wachstum, hohe Kundenzufriedenheit und messbare Geschäftserfolge erzielen.

Dein Daily Business:

  • Strategische Beratung von Kund:innen zu Wachstums- und Geschäftszielen, Budgetstrategien, ROI-Optimierung, Marktpositionierung und Expansion

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen sowie proaktive Identifikation von Bedürfnissen und Entwicklungspotenzialen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Strategien zur Erreichung der Kundenziele

  • Identifikation von Wachstums- und Effizienzchancen sowie Cross-Selling-, Upselling- und Folgeprojektpotenzialen

  • Definition relevanter KPIs, regelmäßige Analyse der Account-Performance und Präsentation umsetzbarer Handlungsempfehlungen

  • Koordination der Zusammenarbeit mit Account Manager:innen, Produkt- und Dienstleistungsspezialist:innen sowie weiteren internen Stakeholdern

  • Einbringen neuer Produkte, Dienstleistungen und datengetriebener Technologien in die strategische Kundenentwicklung

Das macht dich aus

  • Min. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der beratenden Kundenbetreuung sowie grundlegende Erfahrung in der operativen Account-Arbeit

  • Erfahrung im Kundenmanagement, Business Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten zur Interpretation von Daten und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, strategisches Denken, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Talent für die Koordination unterschiedlicher Beteiligter

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die erfolgreiche Kommunikation mit Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen

  • Nice to have: ganzheitliches Verständnis des Marketingmix (SEO, Social Media, CRM)

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Sicherer Hafen: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem innovativen Unternehmen

  • Flexibilität: Home-Office-Option, flexible Arbeitszeiten und spannende Projekte

  • Weiterentwicklung: Fortbildungsbudget, 360°-Feedback und eine Fehlerkultur, in der Lernen wichtiger ist als Stillstand

  • Wissenstauscher: E-Learning-Plattform mit Schulungen, Praxisübungen und Wissen on demand

  • AI Playground: Neueste KI-Tools nutzen, ausprobieren und den AI Change aktiv mitgestalten

  • Buddy-Programm: Persönliche Begleitung durch Fach- und HR-Buddy für einen gelungenen Start

jobs.title: Speculative Applications for Go-To-Market roles
Enterprise Account Executive (UK & Europe)
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive (UK & Europe)

About Firstwork

Firstwork exists so that every frontline worker gets the same personal, 24/7 support in starting and staying in a job that a senior professional gets from a dedicated recruiter, made affordable by AI.

We're an applied AI company running frontline workforce operations for staffing firms and large employers of hourly and shift workers. Our software does the work that sits today with recruiters, compliance teams and outsourced back offices, from a worker's first application into the job itself. We support 150,000 workers a month across more than 80 countries, for customers including Job&Talent, Deel, Wonolo, BGSF, ProLink and Multiplier. Our Series A was led by Earlybird Venture Capital alongside Gradient Ventures and Y Combinator, and we're growing our team in London.

 

The role

Open Firstwork's enterprise market in the UK and Europe, with employers whose frontline workforces span many sites and countries, each with its own rules. That complexity is where Firstwork is strongest. Firstwork sits on top of the systems that customers already use, lands in one workflow or site, and expands across the business.

You'll sell to UK care home groups, logistics and distribution, retail, hospitality and facilities management, plus German facilities management and real estate services. Your buyers are Group HR Directors, Chief People Officers, CFOs, Operations Directors, Heads of Resourcing and Heads of Compliance, with HRIS leads in every deal. They care about CQC and regulator compliance in care, right-to-work across many sites, agency spend, and the cost of hiring and keeping frontline workers at scale.

 

What you'll do

  • Pick named enterprise accounts, get the first meeting and turn it into a funded initiative where no buying process existed

  • Map and multi-thread the whole buying group: champion, economic buyer, blockers, HRIS, security, data protection and procurement

  • Build the business case on labour, compliance and agency cost, and take it through security review and procurement

  • Land in one site or department, then expand site by site and country by country

  • Sell alongside our AI Deployment Specialists, forward-deployed engineers and consulting partners

 

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years closing new business and 2+ years with large UK or European employers

  • You've personally opened named enterprise accounts and turned them into funded initiatives, and you can explain exactly how

  • You've closed six-figure deals through security review and procurement as the lead seller

  • You've sold to group-level buyers (Group HR Director, CPO, CFO, Operations Director), multi-threaded across the business

  • You've expanded accounts site by site after the first land

 

Strong signals

  • A consultative transformation or applied AI background

  • Proof across care, logistics, hospitality, retail or facilities, and you know CQC

  • German, French, Dutch, Spanish or Italian, with relevant frontline-enterprise experience

  • You've started or have an interest in selling AI agents or automation to UK or European enterprises with large frontline workforces

  • You've sold alongside Workday or SAP SuccessFactors

  • You've sold HR, workforce, compliance or care technology

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
jobs.description:
ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring

Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

  • Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

  • Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

  • Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

  • Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

  • Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

  • Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

  • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

  • Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

  • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

  • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

  • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

  • Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

  • Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

  • The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

  • Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

  • Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

  • Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

  • Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

  • A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

  • Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

  • Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

  • Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

  • Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

  • Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

  • Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

  • Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

  • Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

  • Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

  • Profile review and short phone screen

  • Take-home case study

  • Case discussion with the ML team

  • On-site interview and team evaluation

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
AI Engineer (Agentic AI)

Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

  • Strong experience in agentic AI.

  • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

  • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

  • You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

  • You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

  • Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

jobs.title: Compliance & Regulatory Counsel
jobs.description:
Compliance & Regulatory Counsel

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

The Compliance and Regulatory Counsel will act as a key legal partner to deliver and scale critical legal support to a growing global hi-tech SaaS company serving customers that include multi-national enterprises and public sector entities. This role will support the compliance and regulatory function at ExtraHop, advising on laws and regulations directly impacting our business as a SaaS provider, as well as the frameworks governing our enterprise customers. This role supports the corporate and sales compliance function by ensuring accurate and timely filings of various business and regulatory registrations for all jurisdictions in which ExtraHop operates, maintaining the internal database of such filings, staying ahead of legal and regulatory changes and updates and developing internal project roadmaps to ensure timely compliance, and administering compliance programs across multiple legal and risk frameworks.

This role partners with Information Security, Privacy, IT, HR, Finance, Product, and other subject matter experts to develop best practices to understand and advise the business on the legal and regulatory risk technical, security, privacy, and operational information into clear, customer-facing responses.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior- to mid-level attorney with at least 5 years of experience to gain deep, cross-functional exposure to international technology regulations, product/hardware compliance, and cutting-edge AI and privacy governance under the supervision of the Deputy General Counsel and senior legal leadership.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and stakeholder management skills with a working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, compliance frameworks, and enterprise SaaS environments. This role requires the ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment on complex requests, identify appropriate resources, and continuously improve the processes, tools, and knowledge resources that support the sales organization.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Guidance & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Research and advise on complex global regulatory and compliance frameworks affecting ExtraHop as a B2B SaaS provider to enterprise clients.
  • Guide responses for security questionnaires, TPRM assessments, RFIs, RFPs, and high-priority customer due diligence requests.
  • Translate complex technical, security, and legal information into clear, customer-facing documentation.

Data Privacy & AI Governance

  • Partner closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and InfoSec teams to manage regulatory, privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and AI data protection risks.
  • Draft and update critical data privacy agreements (DPAs) and standard contractual clauses (SCCs).
  • Support AI Governance initiatives to ensure ethical and legally sound product deployment.
  • Coordinate and execute corporate governance programs, including facilitating annual Employment/EE compliance training and collecting data for global ESG annual reporting.
  • Serve as a legal stakeholder for independent audits, assisting with readiness and documentation gathering for annual SOC 2 audits, supporting the preparation and distribution of compliance documentation, certifications, attestations, policies, and other customer-facing materials.
  • Maintain and oversee standardized responses and supporting documentation for common privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Draft and update critical data protection documentation, including Data Privacy Agreements (DPAs) and standard contractual clauses (SCCs).
  • Support hardware compliance efforts, including the company’s export control framework and the tracking of and regulatory reporting for environmental supply chain standards.
  • Identify inconsistencies, gaps, or outdated information in customer-facing compliance materials and coordinate updates with the appropriate subject matter experts.
  • Support the implementation of AI Governance frameworks to ensure the ethical, compliant, and legally sound deployment of artificial intelligence capabilities within our products.

Compliance, Audit & Legal Operations

  • Serve as primary legal contact for independent audits, including SOC 2 readiness, policy drafting, and evidence collection.
  • Manage corporate governance tasks, including annual compliance training, global ESG data collection, and export/hardware compliance reporting.
  • Maintain knowledge bases, response libraries, templates, and documentation repositories to increase self-service and improve response efficiency.
  • Support annual corporate insurance review and renewal process, gathering underwriting data across departments (Cyber, D&O, General Liability).
  • Provide ad hoc support on commercial litigation matters, managing document holds, discovery requests, and coordinating logistics with external counsel.
  • Assist with commercial litigation needs, including discovery requests and legal holds.

Key Qualifications

Required:

  • Education & Bar: J.D. or LL.M. with active US state bar membership in good standing.
  • Experience: 5+ years of legal practice with expertise in regulatory compliance, data privacy, cloud/SaaS transactions, and third-party risk management.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Working knowledge of foundational tech and privacy regulations (e.g., GLBA, FERPA, GDPR/US privacy laws) and a strong interest in emerging frameworks like the EU AI Act and DORA.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage multi-stakeholder workflows, prioritize high-volume deliverables, and operate effectively under tight deadlines.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or technology organizations.
  • Professional Privacy Certification (e.g., CIPP/US or CIPP/E).
  • Experience with third-party risk management platforms (TPRM) and regulatory filing platforms such as SAM.gov.

Core Competencies

  • Compliance & Security Acumen – Applies practical knowledge of security, privacy, compliance, and risk requirements to business situations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Coordinates diverse stakeholders and creates accountability for timely and accurate project milestones.
  • Judgment & Prioritization – Distinguishes routine requests from complex or high-risk matters and engages the appropriate subject matter experts.
  • Process & Operational Excellence – Builds scalable processes, improves workflows, and identifies opportunities for automation and self-service legal processes.

The salary for this role is between $180,000 - $200,000 per year + bonus

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
Senior AR Analyst, Credit Control

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

 

Senior AR Analyst, Credit Control | London

Please note: candidate must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

 

About Convene Hospitality Group

Convene Hospitality Group designs and operates experiential event venues, bringing premium meeting and event experiences to some of the world's leading organisations. Through a growing portfolio of brands including Convene, etc.venues and NeueHouse, we operate a network of nearly 40 venues and are the largest single provider of dedicated meeting and event spaces across the US and UK.

The UK is central to that story. From our Convene venues across the City of London to etc.venues in London and Manchester, and with our new West End destination, Convene Rathbone, our UK footprint continues to grow, and so does the pace of the events we deliver. Every conference, board meeting and live event our clients host relies on a finance team that keeps things moving behind the scenes.

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounts Receivable (AR) Analyst, Credit Control to join our UK Finance team and help lead AR operations across our UK venue portfolio. Reporting to the AR Manager, you'll take ownership of billing, credit control and cash allocation, turning client contracts and booking data into accurate, timely invoices, following up on outstanding balances, allocating customer receipts and keeping customer accounts clean and reconciled in our financial systems.

This is a role with real visibility. You'll work closely with Sales, Event Operations and client procurement teams, acting as a trusted partner who keeps cash flowing while protecting the strong client relationships our business is built on. For someone who brings both rigour and a commercial mindset, it's an opportunity to make a direct impact on the financial health of a growing UK business.

 

What You'll Do

Daily Operations & Cash Management:

  • Prepare multi-bank reconciliation spreadsheets (Santander, JPM, Online Credit Cards) and resolve unapplied cash exceptions
  • Process incoming payments (ACH, credit cards, wires, cheques) and apply them accurately to customer accounts in NetSuite
  • Issue final invoices for standard customer accounts and review/process credit memos and billing adjustments with proper approvals
  • Manage customer record updates in NetSuite

Credit Control & Collections:

  • Take direct ownership of chasing overdue accounts via calls, emails, and structured collection cycles
  • Review the AR Aging report weekly to track overdue accounts, identify delinquent trends, and prioritise high-value collection efforts
  • Escalate severely overdue or high-risk accounts to Finance/Sales Management and Legal/Collections where necessary
  • Assess and assign credit limits for new and existing accounts based on payment history and financial reviews

Experience Required

  • 5+ years of dedicated Accounts Receivable or Finance experience
  • Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or comparable ERPs) and intermediate to advanced Excel
  •  

    Experience managing key enterprise client accounts, including submitting and tracking invoices via customer supplier portals (e.g. Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tungsten Network), purchase order-led invoicing and resolving rejected or queried invoices, is a strong advantage

  • Solid understanding of month-end AR reconciliations
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and cross-functional communication



We're Here For You:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect:

  • Health & Wellness: Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.
  • Time Off & Balance: 25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay.
  • Financial Benefits: Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.
  • Growth & Recognition: Career development opportunities and programs to celebrate your achievements.
  • Community & Impact: Volunteer, donate, and make a real impact through your work.

 

At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team.

Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.description:
Partner Manager - German Speaker

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology — increasingly agentic — solutions they build and sell.

This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia. In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

Algolia's partner motion in DACH is mature — we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Developing and executing Algolia's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland
  • Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH
  • Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region
  • Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions
  • Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners
  • Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market
  • Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users
  • Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation
  • Enabling partners on Algolia's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully
  • Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio
  • Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content
  • Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits
  • Collaborating closely with the DACH General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals
  • Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success
  • Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the DACH partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • 7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer
  • Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners
  • Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators active in the German market (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech, Diconium)
  • Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures
  • A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally with strength in the German market and familiarity with Austria and Switzerland
  • Fluency in German (spoken and written) is required, given the primary focus on the German market; fluency in English is also required
  • Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships
  • A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a multi-country region
  • A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities

On-Target Earnings Pay Range

£108,000—£150,000 GBP

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. jobs.title: Content Writer
jobs.description:
Content Writer

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Content Writer to help shape how Paddle shows up in the world. This is a writing role for someone who can take complex product ideas and push the boundaries of B2B content with bold stories, turning product launches, feature releases and customer problems into work people genuinely want to read.

We’re looking for strong storytelling, journalistic instincts and a clear point of view, with the craft to make complicated subjects memorable.

You’ll adapt ideas for different audiences and channels.
You’ll use AI tools thoughtfully while maintaining human judgement, accuracy and originality. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing, Communications, Design and subject-matter experts to develop content with a clear point of view.

What you’ll do

  • Develop original, customer-centric editorial and product content across our content ecosystem.

  • Find sharp angles and strong points of view for product stories, launches, campaigns, customer stories and other content.

  • Turn product strategy, customer problems and technical detail into clear narratives that build understanding and adoption.

  • Apply SEO principles without compromising originality, clarity or readability.

  • Use audience insight, search data and performance data to inform content decisions.

  • Adapt strong ideas across formats and channels.

  • Collaborate with Design and cross-functional partners to bring ideas to life, using Figma.

  • Help maintain our TOV, raise Paddle’s editorial standards and writing quality.

We’d love to hear from you if you are

  • An experienced writer, journalist, editor or content specialist with a strong body of published work across a variety of channels.

  • Comfortable writing about tech, business or complex subject, finding the human angle.

  • Skilled at turning product strategy, customer interviews, research and expert input into engaging stories.

  • Comfortable challenging a brief when there is a better story, sharper angle or more useful way to serve the audience.

  • Experienced with SEO fundamentals.

  • Understanding content performance and how it shapes your work.

  • Able to manage multiple briefs and deadlines without losing sight of quality.

  • Confidence to work with AI tools and design platforms, such as Figma.

You do not need to have worked in B2B tech. We’re more interested in your ability to understand complex subjects, ask good questions and challenge the norms of our industry.

What we’re looking for in your portfolio

Please include examples that demonstrate:

  • Must-have: Two pieces that shows range e.g. short-form to long-form

  • Must-have: A customer story, case study or interview-led piece

  • Nice-to-have: An example piece of content as part of a Product launch/activation

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Search

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London/Cardiff/UK Remote | £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

About our Machine Learning Search Team

We are currently embarking on one of our two top strategic priorities to make Money work for Everyone: building the Monzo Co-pilot. We are becoming an intelligent, proactive ally that handles the complexity of users financial life. We aren't just selling financial products; we are building a truly smart agent that understands users, anticipates their needs, and helps people reach their financial goals.

Our ML Search team brings together Backend, Product, Machine Learning Scientists and Data Scientists. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll build and ship models that help customers search for and find answers about their financial lives. You'll make it effortless for them to find the right products at the exact moment they need them.

Whether it’s surfacing the right savings product at the perfect moment, helping customers manage their spending, or simplifying financial planning, our work makes banking smarter, more intuitive, and truly customer-first.

Head of Customer Operations

Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence.

Happy Money’s end-to-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $7 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy here.

Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company based in the United States. Remote work doesn’t mean less work, we work full-time jobs and show up to them fully every day. To learn more about our values and the way we work, review our Happy Money Way Overview!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an execution-focused Head of Customer Operations to lead our Loan Fulfillment, Customer Experience, and Collections teams. Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer you will have full ownership of the entire operations function, including managing operational teams, driving initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness, optimizing the applicant experience, and overseeing key third-party vendor relationships.

This role is instrumental in delivering a seamless, secure, and highly efficient lending experience, with significant emphasis placed on collections effectiveness, streamlining the applicant verifications process, and driving improvements in application-to-funding pull-through rates. You’ll ensure robust risk controls, continuously improve operational processes, and collaborate cross-functionally to scale operations and implement strategies that balance growth, efficiency, customer satisfaction, and rigorous risk management.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and Drive Operational Strategy:
    Define, track, and evolve critical performance metrics across operations, prioritizing scalability, efficiency, and execution. Proactively optimize processes that enhance verification efficiency, increase pull-through rates, and elevate the applicant and borrower experience.
  • Optimize Loan Application and Verification Processes:
    Lead efforts to streamline and accelerate the application-to-funding journey. Implement best-in-class verification processes that reduce friction, increase conversion, and support scalable growth.
  • Enhance Collections and Servicing:
    Lead the development and continuous refinement of collections strategies to improve performance , reduce losses, and maintain exceptional customer interactions throughout the repayment lifecycle.
  • Elevate the Customer and Applicant Experience:
    Advocate strongly for the Voice of the Customer, ensuring every interaction—from initial application to loan servicing—is frictionless and supportive. Continuously measure and enhance customer satisfaction while balancing growth, risk, and operational efficiency.
  • Vendor and Partner Management:
    Fully own relationships with third-party service providers, ensuring vendors effectively support collections, underwriting verification processes, fraud detection, and customer service objectives. Ensure strong performance accountability with all external partners.
  • Build a Culture of Operational Excellence:
    Recruit, mentor, and develop operational leaders and their teams, creating a culture focused on accountability, execution, efficiency, and data driven decision making.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
    Actively collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to align operations with broader company objectives, ensuring seamless integration and execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Drive Process and Technology Improvements:
    Proactively identify and implement automation, be comfortable with implementing AI agents, and advanced analytics that significantly improve operational efficiency, pull-through rates, collections effectiveness, and the overall customer experience.
  • Ensure Compliance and Robust Risk Management:
    Maintain rigorous compliance practices and embed strong risk controls within loan operations, verifications, servicing, and collections.

Note: This role requires quarterly in-person domestic/international travel for vendor and BPO visits.

ABOUT YOU

  • 10+ years of experience in loan operations, servicing, verifications, and collections, with deep expertise in collections and proven experience optimizing verification processes and improving pull-through rates.
  • 5+ years of senior leadership experience managing high-performing operational teams, demonstrating success in developing talent and fostering accountability and high performance.
  • Track record of optimizing and scaling operations, specifically enhancing collections processes, verification efficiency, and application-to-funding conversion.
  • Strong experience overseeing operational processes related to fraud prevention, verification, and customer support, with demonstrated capability in balancing exceptional customer experiences with risk management and operational efficiency.
  • Proven ability to effectively balance growth initiatives with rigorous compliance and risk management in regulated financial environments.
  • Customer-focused mindset, ensuring all applicant and borrower interactions remain efficient, supportive, and frictionless throughout their lending journey.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or related field required.
  • Experience in FinTech, consumer lending, personal loans, or high-growth financial services companies.

BONUS POINTS FOR
